Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.

Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

* Protecting the unborn,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. * Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

---|---|---

| | **YOUR SIGNATURE IS MISSING: Act now to help CANCEL the sale of Wyoming public lands to corporate frackers before National Public Lands Day this weekend! >> [_Add your signature!_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1999976?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) ** Picture this: a storybook sunrise on America’s beautiful western plains. A majestic bird fluffs its feathers, strutting through the brush. This is the iconic Greater sage-grouse, known for its unique dancing courtship displays and proud tail feathers.** ** Fossil fuel extraction has DECIMATED this special bird’s population. Now, the Department of Interior is about to lease **more than 13,000 acres** of public lands in Wyoming – **_including critical sage-grouse habitat_** – to greedy polluters. **October 2nd is the LAST DAY you can submit comments on this lease sale before public lands are forever changed.** [_**Friend, tell the DOI: cancel the Wyoming lease sale! Protect our public lands and wildlife from greedy polluters. >> **_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1999977?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1999978?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
This Saturday is National Public Lands Day. Now is as important a time as ever to take action to stop fossil fuel corporations from destroying our country’s beautiful scenery. But it’s not just our land and wildlife at risk.
Fracking and oil drilling create **TOXIC POLLUTION** and **FOUL ODORS** that snake their way into nearby communities and hurt people. Some of the side effects that have been reported include **lightheadedness, nausea, and respiratory illnesses.**
**The comment period to oppose this Wyoming lease sale is closing fast, Friend. [If just 1 of every 8 people reading this email takes action, we can send a powerful message to the DOI and help cancel the lease sale! Act now!](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1999979?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1999978?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Travis Nembhard is an attorney, a former financial regulator, and a former administrative law judge.
As delegate for VA-22, he wants to help create a better community for his family. His personal experiences as a parent motivate him to lighten the burden for other working families, including universal childcare and paid family leave. His goal is to empower as many residents as possible by working with them to address their issues. As a lifelong public servant and advocate, his focus is to combat injustices, inequality, government overreach, and misinformation, along with ensuring that our Commonwealth is transparent, accessible, and representative of all Virginians.

### Diaper Drive with Huddle Up Moms!

September is National Diaper Need Awareness Month! That's why Huddle Up Moms is launching the first ever Roanoke Diaper Duty! HUM is challenging teams in our community to register for this annual diaper and wipe drive to help us tackle diaper needs in our community and ensure every baby has a clean start.
1 in 2 U.S. families struggles to provide enough diapers to keep a baby or toddler clean, dry, and healthy - your donation will help change that!
On October 14 all teams will be invited to The Haven to hand off their collections for a diaper drop-off dance party! At the dance party, your team is welcome to help sort out diapers and wipes, take photos, get a tour of the Haven, enjoy some light refreshments. All participating teams will also receive an official Diaper Duty 2023 certificate that you can display proudly in your business, office, or team headquarters!
Roanoke Diaper Duty 2023 will take place from September 20 - October 14. Deadline to sign up and participate is September 27.

We have exciting news here at Team Daniels, and we wanted to make sure you didn't miss it!
We've teamed up Tamie Wilson, the Democrat challenging Scott Perry's favorite Freedom Caucus flunkie, Jim Jordan. Team Daniels and Team Wilson are working together to beat both of these dangerous members of Congress, and we need your help.
If you missed it, check out Shamaine's message below introducing Tamie and her campaign and consider making a contribution to help both candidates win in 2024.
You can contribute by clicking here, or using any of the links in the message below and your contribution will be automatically split between the Daniels and Wilson campaigns! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-shamaine?refcode=TWemail1]
As always, thank you for being a vital part of our team as we all fight for better representation in Congress!
- Team Daniels

From: Shamaine Daniels
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-shamaine?refcode=TWemail1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-shamaine?refcode=TWemail1]
Dear Friend,
I would like to introduce you to someone very important, Tamie Wilson. Tamie is the Democrat challenging insurrectionist Congressman Jim Jordan in Ohio's 4th District.
As we know, Jim Jordan is one of Scott Perry’s top Freedom Caucus flunkies. Whether they are trying to help Donald Trump steal an election, or threatening to shut down the government to promote their extremist agenda, Jordan and Perry are literal partners in crime. Jim Jordan even came to Harrisburg for Perry’s “Stop the Steal” rally that terrorized residents of our district..
Put simply, Jim Jordan and Scott Perry are dangerous, and part of what makes them so dangerous is that through all of their Freedom Caucus schemes to push a radical agenda, Perry and Jordan work together.

Tamie and I have news for them. Those of us that want to protect Democracy, build a better and fairer world with more and better opportunities, and who want to see government work to improve the lives of the American People can stick together too. That is why I am introducing you to Tamie Wilson.
Tamie is an entrepreneur, and small business owner who has experienced her share of adversity. She was able to overcome the challenges in her path and build a better life for her family, and she is running for Congress to ensure that all Americans have those same opportunities. You can learn more about Tamie on her website TamieWilson.com [tamiewilson.com]
Can you pitch-in $25, $50, $100, $250 or more to support Tami and I as we fight to defat Jim Jordan and Scott Perry? CLICK here to donate now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-shamaine?refcode=TWemail1]
You'll be hearing more from both of us, and in the months ahead, Tamie and I will be working together to help each other build the strongest campaigns possible. We’re sticking together, just like Jordan and Perry. What makes us stronger than them is all of you . Together, we are all fighting to end the extremist politics of Donald Trump, Scott Perry, Jim Jordan, and the Freedom Caucus, and together WE CAN WIN!
With gratitude,
Shamaine

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: I want to know your thoughts
body:
There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried

|
---
| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zran3vsk95ilughh5vsf5u182j0ss0bqrdei6teo_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi6aor2cjh2bs)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zbfcpcd0ijv6hlfqg1tkrp5r82u1gv3a1pm3k3s8_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi6aor2cjh2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z2v30q3kdghbn8v8ogv7ar18g8s9ha4rlvrdq5b0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi6aor2cjh2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2ze99j320mqgfktcm751appp38pim0kqvtud9sab0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi6aor2cjh2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

name: Vivek Ramaswamy
subject: Abolish the administrative state

body:
This is our opportunity to shut down the Administrative, Deep State. It’s time to revive America

|
Fellow American,

America was born from a revolution.

The creation of our nation didn't happen from moderate, incremental change. It happened through radical change. That's why I am unveiling my plan to SHUT DOWN the Administrative, Deep State.

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2za30ot37nuenl42b9q6snlb2o05b0fr5nnava82o_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi66ob7c9h2bs)
Here's something I've learned as a CEO. If someone works for you and you cannot fire them - they don't work for you, **YOU** work for _them_.

We must shut down the fourth branch of government. They don't have the same political oversight as Members of Congress or the President. You cannot fire them on Election Day. That's why we need a system of checks and balances when it comes to the administrative state.

**[Will you join me in my plan in shutting down the administrative state?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ze6fmhfqqdd9qru8an11rsg8d9pu9j7t6oib86a0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi66ob7c9h2bs)**

**[Shut down the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI)](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zendj2cp6gcv3dead1me3ut9qs9994aujrd5q8v0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi66ob7c9h2bs)**
**[Shut down the Department of Education (DoEd)](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zq2tq7a9ucqb99qhv6j2cnqujbcmqbiuoenpg7tg_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi66ob7c9h2bs)**
**[Shut down the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC)](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvhdf9bpq4s6iig7ff60rtb60e2nkqui3jplnej8_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi66ob7c9h2bs)**
**[Shut down the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, and Firearms (AFT)](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zsvt8aih60vt8vv72k5ie7vmq7vu7jrdh2jcip58_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi66ob7c9h2bs)**
**[Shut down the Food and Nutrition Services (FNS)](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zp3lu39v40a05q6grge136q3ui3tu81d67e9mdeo_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi66ob7c9h2bs)**

Bureaucracy is a formula for corruption. **[It's time to end the weaponization of the fourth branch of government in America once and for all.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvgcnff56a8lo5ihfp8un39r70l4f4l9shg6n1fo_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi66ob7c9h2bs)**

Most Republicans favor reform. I favor revolution.

Any politician who says they're going to “fix” the deep state is delusional. The administrative state is unconstitutional. The right answer: *shut it down.* You can't tame the Leviathan - you have to slay it.

Here's the TRUTH: **If you strike the swamp,_the swamp strikes back._ **

Fellow American, I need to know if you're with me as we fundamentally disrupt Washington. We've got to unite together to show the swamp that we will not sit ideally by and allow for corruption to continue in DC.

This won't be popular with the Establishment, so I am counting on you to join me if you're ready for real change.

**[Add your name to our growing movement by letting me know if you agree with our plan to take back our government.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z17csvfnsi16vn40hpe60tdqd3vudsksv552rsfg_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi66ob7c9h2bs)**

Thanks,

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z25sb4lag3e5ll2p1alp2jeo4endqimoln2rn1o0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi66ob7c9h2bs)
Vivek Ramaswamy

| [** SHUT DOWN THE ADMINISTRATIVE STATE -> **](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6vgl5th1c8dg5agtodstjggdeb9u6au1je0m2q8_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi66ob7c9h2bs)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

[** STAND WITH VIVEK ➞ **](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvtcupa9fauhkj2a4492clrjd7u13jfv3h7p0r4g_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi66ob7c9h2bs)

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: I want to know your thoughts
body:
There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried

|
---
| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z1fecmnkkl5fmfsks9pvudolccoipseef935pc6o_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi6eob6c9h2bs)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zopeo49vmgiql6on5is7theqmns3egit0f5924v0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi6eob6c9h2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zts1j8onp75eafimocb861gplo8nhq1unieh9u80_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi6eob6c9h2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z335isknhi2h6b7gdo7c1hgtci6dos8s8vdgar3o_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpi6eob6c9h2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

# [If House Republicans shut down the government, stop paying their salaries](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tad35fcbc-61af-45f8-ba40-b3b8d1fc3eee/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | Kevin McCarthy is breaking the budget deal he made with President Biden, and is pushing for dramatic cuts and extremist policy provisions in the budget he sends to the Senate. He knows it will be rejected, and he knows that means a government shutdown. But he doesn't care. **Well, maybe taking away his salary would make him care.** [**Add your name, and demand that If House Republicans shut down the government, they don't get paid. **](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1d7c27a7-2665-4624-818f-e6a6d34fb45f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Not during the shutdown, _and no retroactive pay after it's over_ (as has been done previously). If Republicans can't do their jobs -- even the bare minimum -- they should not get paid. Period. [**Add your name, and demand that If House Republicans shut down the government, they don't get paid.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf2f4a8f2-1421-4735-b088-e233dafa1670/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

body:
We have the capacity to go on offense and change the course of history for our kids.

Friends -
The future is not something to experience, it's something to manifest. It's decisions, not conditions, that determine our fate and future.
The other side is counting on us to give up and give in.
They want us to believe that it doesn't matter what laws states like California or even Congress pass, that the courts will just throw them out. So why even try?
No.
We have the capacity to go on offense and change the course of history for our kids. Because guns are the number one killer of our kids, and we have the capacity to turn that around.
That is what the Right to Safety Constitutional Amendment does.
[](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/2884?t=1&akid=1572%2E4767699%2ELsUt3A)
Thank you for being a part of this fight from the start. Now it’s time to expand our efforts beyond California.
Gavin
* * *
👋🏻 Wait ... Before you click away! 🇺🇸
Now that California became the first state to call for a Constitutional Amendment on gun safety, we need to get this thing introduced and passed in other states.
That takes work. It takes organizing. And it's work we are committed to doing. But Gavin Newsom can't do it alone.
So please. If contributing $20 today feels like it's worth expanding this effort to other states, make that donation here. It's people like you who will help us continue to make progress on this issue. Thank you.

name: Craig Segall, Evergreen
subject: Tell EPA: Put communities and climate first
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY EVERGREEN COLLABORATIVE
body:
This one rule can save lives, clean our air, and tackle climate
| | | | | [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/3139?t=2&akid=13693%2E53494%2EYOjIuH)
---
|
---
| | **TELL EPA: STAND UP FOR COMMUNITIES AND KIDS WITH A STRONGER CLEAN TRUCKS PLAN** EPA is close to finalizing its heavy-duty vehicle rule, **but the agency might miss the chance to include life-saving updates.** Join us in demanding a stronger rule that will drive big shifts towards zero-emission vehicles and protect our communities.
---
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5027?t=4&akid=13693%2E53494%2EYOjIuH)
---
| | Friend, What if I told you that the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) could protect thousands of lives, clean up our air, and get more electric vehicles on the road by strengthening _just one rule_?

**That's what's on the table as EPA finalizes its heavy-duty vehicle rule. **

If big industry groups like the Engine Manufacturers Association and American Trucking Association get their way, EPA will miss this opportunity to fight for our communities—**unless it feels pressure from folks like you. **

**[Urge EPA to stand up to the big truck industry groups by setting a standard that gets us to 100 percent zero-emission trucks by 2030.](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5027?t=5&akid=13693%2E53494%2EYOjIuH)**

---
[**TELL EPA: PUT COMMUNITIES AND CLIMATE FIRST**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5027?t=7&akid=13693%2E53494%2EYOjIuH)
---
This rule would help us transition away from diesel trucks, which are so dangerous that areas with heavy truck traffic are literally called "diesel death zones."

**Addressing this kind of pollution can mean healthier lives and cleaner air for the predominantly Black, Brown, and lower-income communities who are more likely to live by transportation infrastructure. **

In short, there's no better time to get this done.
---
[**SIGN ON**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5027?t=9&akid=13693%2E53494%2EYOjIuH)
---
Onward, Craig Segall
Vice President of Policy
Evergreen Collaborative
---
|
---

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ZAK FOR CONGRESS
body:
#
**PragerU is invading our public schools to push a far-right agenda:** [_Sign our petition to keep PragerU out of our schools!_](https://act.zakforcongress.com/go/121?t=1&akid=456%2E8507%2EugYtUo)
---

**Public education is under attack:** From DeSantis’s book bans to erasing slavery from the syllabus, a small nonprofit called PragerU is leading the disinformation charge.

PragerU makes videos that will be shown in Florida and Oklahoma classrooms where cartoons explain the “benefits” of slavery, how Christopher Columbus meant no harm to native Americans, and why renewable energies are “unreliable.”

_**Even the nonprofit’s founder admitted that their material is specifically designed for indoctrination.**_

[But here’s what you can do about it:](https://act.zakforcongress.com/go/121?t=2&akid=456%2E8507%2EugYtUo) [_Sign our petition today to tell your local leaders to keep PragerU out of our schools!!_](https://act.zakforcongress.com/go/121?t=3&akid=456%2E8507%2EugYtUo)

[SIGN ON:](https://act.zakforcongress.com/go/121?t=4&akid=456%2E8507%2EugYtUo)

[_*We need 5,000 signatures by midnight tonight*_](https://act.zakforcongress.com/go/121?t=5&akid=456%2E8507%2EugYtUo)
The introduction of PragerU materials in schools is a national concern, not just local. Parents and educators must be aware of the skewed perspectives these materials offer, often masked as "alternative viewpoints."

We believe in an education system that provides a balanced view of the world, allowing students to form their own opinions. PragerU's one-sided content undermines this principle and threatens the quality of our education.

Our children deserve an education that equips them with the tools to think critically and independently. Let's ensure that our schools remain a place for unbiased learning, not a platform for propaganda.

[RIGHT NOW:](https://act.zakforcongress.com/go/121?t=6&akid=456%2E8507%2EugYtUo) [_Sign our petition to keep PragerU OUT of our public schools for good!_](https://act.zakforcongress.com/go/121?t=7&akid=456%2E8507%2EugYtUo)

Malamed HQ

| | Oregon has new gun laws...

Massachusetts has new gun laws...

The ATF is making everyone who owns a firearm with a pistol brace an "automatic felon"...

And earlier this year, the Idaho Supreme Court took away our ability to carry guns in publicly owned spaces!

Idaho is one of the most gun-friendly states in the union.

But with the encroachment of leftist chumps on our freedoms, things could change quite quickly.

_This is war...

_

And the battle to keep Idaho a 2A sanctuary state is real.

The libs won't do it.

The squishy politicians in the middle _might believe it_... but they won't sound the alarm and fight against it.

That's why I'm a loud and proud member of the Idaho Freedom Caucus.

__We'll go to the mats on this every single time.__

Because we're in this fight to win, and anything less would betray our Constitutional Republic.

Someone once said that "an armed society is a polite society."

And of course, I agree.

But being "nice" and "polite" isn't how we win the fight for our second amendment rights.

We have to be relentless, unyielding, and uncompromising.

We've got to be warriors, ready to stand our ground and refuse to back down.

No half-measures, no compromises.

It's all in, or get out.

That's how we win this thing.

Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within -- and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We've reached the point in our history that will decide our future - and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That's why I'll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left's evil agenda to every American patriot.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2949dc67136046959623dcca99fa16fd&_e=B-Akb8Be6ruZ7vTw1D30nS0hN1kXzA9wIArpIRe36b95ZPa0c6Xh7khNdolTa9LE1sdm-_I7auVUwtmUafkxzISFW_IYrrRerMCh3jVKftLAKM5h2lcFlMvgYtLYNw8IVZtTI5hCECPL1jqL9iYtjUCc5nGdRZv2SeVgTeCOaGZZIey7eNpVQEV83yL5RMTafgFA2xuI8s0XGDQcSGmNxlWPb6HXD9nz4iwae6_oSqu9AMqHdEJLKtSSwdBTcclkgi2VvviKv1xaGS39tKh_HRbrwPVaZQg8WWgXPmsOk6Mn08gnhi2Wks6IT6QvGYbmYHM32X-VQA_FYkNnt0RO8G4FqHMk9pQ7gri0sEmz1WIpq61f-zj50WGW0UG2HgPaq-BuID8QLHZr4m2UFgDQvQ%3D%3D)** The Left is at war with America. Keir will always fight for fairness, opportunity and justice. If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | Peter, there is a lot at stake this election, including the most fundamental tenet of our democracy — the right to VOTE and for your vote to be COUNTED. Gov. Josh Shapiro just announced automatic voter registration when applying for a new driver’s license in the commonwealth — it’s a major step forward because it means more people will have the opportunity to participate in our democracy. But what happens when the votes themselves are challenged? That’s where Keir comes in... The Attorney General’s office is essential to upholding the integrity of our elections — from protecting your access to the ballot box on Election Day, to defending mail-in voting, to combating voter suppression and misinformation, to ultimately defending the sacred right for your vote to be counted against those who would overturn your ballot for extreme partisan political gain. Dear Friends,

Would you send a $100 bill in the mail?

How much do you trust the federal government via the postal service with your sacred ballot?

Not me.

If you say there's no problem, then by all means please go ahead and mail $100 cash to a friend. Or better yet, keep that money (Biden's inflation has made losing $100 too costly for too many) and vote in-person.

Everyone should make a plan to vote. For me, I'm voting in-person on Election Day, November 7.

Who is to say bad actors won't throw the Republican marked ballots away?

For God & Country,
Amanda Chase

My name is Ken Mauer. I’m one of the longest-tenured referees in NBA history, spanning five different decades and over 2,100 regular season games, which was abruptly ended when I was forced out of the league because of my faith-based objections to the hastily-developed COVID injection.

Now they’re trying to bankrupt me, withholding my pension – money I’ve EARNED over a long and successful career. They’re trying to lay siege to me and lawyer me to death. The hypocrisy of the NBA is stunning, as they're letting players PLAY, but I can no longer referee - a craft I spent my life doing and loved!

Peter, this is the kind of headline I love waking up to: [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zEPIFSjzYV6zoc2BVIgWh3icad793PAu0856Ug9MQliaSOcF8kZaTmVYMpF8R9MUaLdOYmVGOCnNCEXZ6BvyltGdV0-8fTdwsTf0hKG15McsgapLT-_iOWD5UNDDvVinLmGACQU-BdEHT2sJZXChpIyCS3N6BSki2XLQEJrSLho09o0PDYGb9vWTPmG_TX20bHDz1IzzAxOWs4AybgpmiJQD_om6jtrAF1bFsBgoY08LuZoLGHupYesdgaSMI6wDA2dZSsfR1gI-PP-vjaRnez6TcZAUv60KoLvQsJM4tx2z18gnh1-Jrd4g3eb1XCOvrm1WIcTYk8VmD8uQ7-2DJpvG76wyF1MPNty94bjlYP4XjZfmd-Fpn-j256VOEIWxBYQ1Q0ob3dBBxi1HWu9c9aS7BAdTdP6RP8X_zs-YwNBbuly4D6_i8FLUk1XCAasOg/3zs/1L3MeHaZR8qJukt9Z0suVw/h0/DI7biy6T6qdumEqK-VbPIATAZDcC_VWD3mswzbZwcT0) Just this week, Democrats flipped a seat in the New Hampshire House -- a R+6 seat at that! -- bringing us one step closer to breaking the GOP’s majority there. And in Pennsylvania, we held onto our majority in the state House, adding to a growing list of Democratic election victories this year:
* **Florida:** Democrat**** Donna Deegan’s win in Jacksonville marked just the second time Democrats have won a mayor’s race in the city in the last 30 years. She won by four points in a city that Republican Ron DeSantis won by 11 in 2022.
* **Kentucky:** Democratic state Senate candidate Cassie Chambers Armstrong won by 54 points in a district that a Democrat won by 23 in 2016.
* **Ohio:** If passed,**** Ohio’s Issue 1 ballot measure would have raised the threshold to codify the right to an abortion into the state constitution this November. The measure failed by 14 points in a state that Republican JD Vance won by 6 points in 2022.
* **Tennessee:** Democrat Justin Jones defeated Republican Lauren Nelson by 55 points in a district a Democrat won by 44 in 2020.
* **Virginia:** Democrat Jennifer McClellan defeated Republican nominee Leon Benjamin by 50 points in a D+16 district.
* **Wisconsin** : Liberal candidate Janet Protasiewicz won the Wisconsin Supreme Court race by 11 points, outperforming all statewide Democrats’ 2022 margins.

**These aren’t just one-off election wins. They prove that our message is resonating with voters -- and that we can’t write off any corner of the country.[**(If you agree and want to keep up our momentum, chip in now!)**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zEPIFSjzYV6zoc2BVIgWh3icad793PAu0856Ug9MQliaSOcF8kZaTmVYMpF8R9MUaLdOYmVGOCnNCEXZ6BvyltGdV0-8fTdwsTf0hKG15McsgapLT-_iOWD5UNDDvVinKuXR8Qi6SVvXvP2T0d2B_Du-HICwMJe84SbRSVLwUHO6MVFvEWNVYrvES9Kw-XCcnE1BbS42Gjhy6x8qKIbvc3gjMMZmIk98-9CPX6ZVfx1mmkkBFSipjBf9Wy3M0W-Rpa9ShkG9laqxcHMT03H7a4e7mkGr2AnfYuUDPd1dCrYkRRIg6aARl0KX1PO5uKiFBY810yQPvhhh-9ScZzbLjJw3NfRIbX174QY989ZApZO-C5DsHrQp1cChLvcYyjZ9GLFyoWSusu334QiN-bZ2nsM9dxOmSGMK_OUXhnYEigfl13F_nzze4cjM3tJy2R8HE/3zs/1L3MeHaZR8qJukt9Z0suVw/h1/MggOytmOFX2S6JNMj3N1L7OfvvIeW1cXXnWAxUePK8A) ** _In Republican-leaning areas and Democratic strongholds alike, people see how Joe and Kamala have delivered for them and their communities._ After they were sworn in, Joe and Kamala hit the ground running to pass the American Rescue Plan -- which enabled us to get vaccines out, reopen businesses and schools, and get the pandemic under control. Then, they introduced once-in-a-generation legislation to bring down costs for working people and combat climate change, passed the most significant federal gun safety legislation in decades, and made massive investments in rebuilding and improving our roads, bridges, highways, ports, internet, and railroads. As an American, it makes me proud to know everything that Joe and Kamala have accomplished. And, as their campaign manager, it makes me even prouder to know that voters are recognizing the impact of their work. But we cannot slow down now. **We have to continue getting our message out there to ensure that _every person_ knows what Joe and Kamala have accomplished in their first term -- and how a second term can help finish the job. ** [**I hope you’ll consider pitching in $25 -- or anything you’re able -- today so that we can keep building Democratic power from local office to the Oval Office.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zEPIFSjzYV6zoc2BVIgWh3icad793PAu0856Ug9MQliaSOcF8kZaTmVYMpF8R9MUaLdOYmVGOCnNCEXZ6BvyltGdV0-8fTdwsTf0hKG15McsgapLT-_iOWD5UNDDvVinJMlvUd3Ox9tPc_sRC6jMQ6KyWhWSASo-DFU3oUs-ZAOP7AA-GC2ValHjs3BDYtPlGpsTQAwtbCtg9dqTe6uIoj6YIQb3rGJq5cnKvRDweOI6mg47Y50InN612FsM-UWkaYflreurH-NA7eL0WrEECTAY9aDuiiYRTKcHO92IZENi9CTPzRJCceKUiZkzMYhn91xrNLH5qKd_Tbb2A87qgFG91nYTZCLOHNeAPiYAwRpXcMjmKBpHZfZmSiaHCTs9u7o7Dno3wJnJJGq23wQeQJm3mPwB1M7KevaF_cRByOiE8-Kr9BzxtcitkvV9z-hjk/3zs/1L3MeHaZR8qJukt9Z0suVw/h2/Jhc2mTBv2neT0V8ZMaovXl3kKdtDlMjf5oEf2rSVrmI) From the very beginning, this campaign has been made up of thousands of donors all over the country -- folks chipping in a few dollars a time because they believe in President Biden and Vice President Harris’ vision for our country and are ready to keep pushing forward for progress. clean_body: We have to continue getting our message out there to ensure that every person knows what Joe and Kamala have accomplished. | | | Peter, this is the kind of headline I love waking up to: Just this week, Democrats flipped a seat in the New Hampshire House -- a R+6 seat at that! -- bringing us one step closer to breaking the GOP’s majority there. And in Pennsylvania, we held onto our majority in the state House, adding to a growing list of Democratic election victories this year: Florida: Democrat Donna Deegan’s win in Jacksonville marked just the second time Democrats have won a mayor’s race in the city in the last 30 years. She won by four points in a city that Republican Ron DeSantis won by 11 in 2022. Kentucky: Democratic state Senate candidate Cassie Chambers Armstrong won by 54 points in a district that a Democrat won by 23 in 2016. Ohio: If passed, Ohio’s Issue 1 ballot measure would have raised the threshold to codify the right to an abortion into the state constitution this November. The measure failed by 14 points in a state that Republican JD Vance won by 6 points in 2022. Tennessee: Democrat Justin Jones defeated Republican Lauren Nelson by 55 points in a district a Democrat won by 44 in 2020. Virginia: Democrat Jennifer McClellan defeated Republican nominee Leon Benjamin by 50 points in a D+16 district. Wisconsin : Liberal candidate Janet Protasiewicz won the Wisconsin Supreme Court race by 11 points, outperforming all statewide Democrats’ 2022 margins. These aren’t just one-off election wins. They prove that our message is resonating with voters -- and that we can’t write off any corner of the country. In Republican-leaning areas and Democratic strongholds alike, people see how Joe and Kamala have delivered for them and their communities. After they were sworn in, Joe and Kamala hit the ground running to pass the American Rescue Plan -- which enabled us to get vaccines out, reopen businesses and schools, and get the pandemic under control. Then, they introduced once-in-a-generation legislation to bring down costs for working people and combat climate change, passed the most significant federal gun safety legislation in decades, and made massive investments in rebuilding and improving our roads, bridges, highways, ports, internet, and railroads. As an American, it makes me proud to know everything that Joe and Kamala have accomplished. And, as their campaign manager, it makes me even prouder to know that voters are recognizing the impact of their work. But we cannot slow down now. We have to continue getting our message out there to ensure that every person knows what Joe and Kamala have accomplished in their first term -- and how a second term can help finish the job. From the very beginning, this campaign has been made up of thousands of donors all over the country -- folks chipping in a few dollars a time because they believe in President Biden and Vice President Harris’ vision for our country and are ready to keep pushing forward for progress. Thank you for being on this team, Peter. \-- Julie Julie Chavez Rodriguez Campaign Manager Biden-Harris 2024

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. **ATTORNEY GENERAL GARLAND AND FBI DIRECTOR WRAY SUED BY J-6 PEACEFUL PROTESTERS OVER ILLEGAL SURVEILLANCE**
_Class Action Could Result in Prosecutions and Convictions Being Thrown Out_ _**Over One Billion USD in Jury Award Requested**_ (Northern District of Florida, September 21, 2023). Today, Larry Klayman, Esq., the founder of both Freedom Watch and Judicial Watch, and now the Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, announced the filing of a class action lawsuit against Biden Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray and their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice, for ordering and carrying out illegal surveillance concerning the peaceful protesters of January 6, 2021 (hereafter ‘J-6’) , prohibited under Section 702 of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act. The class action complaint, styled _Rivera et. al v. FBI et. al, Civil Action No. 3:23-CV-24547_ was filed before the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Florida and requests an award of over a Billion USD to the January 6, 2021 victims of this illegal surveillance. That this illegal surveillance occurred and was trained on J-6 peaceful protesters is not in dispute and has been widely disclosed and reported upon by major news organizations. Previously, in a case styled Klayman v. Obama et. al, Civil Action No.1:13-CV-00851 (D.D.C. 2013), Klayman had previously obtained preliminary injunctions against the Obama-Biden NSA when it was revealed by Edward Snowden that identical mass surveillance had been illegally conducted against hundreds of millions of Americans. A copy of the class action complaint is embedded below and can be viewed at [www.freedomwatchusa.org](https://freedomwatchusa.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=72bc9b8de1fa17e6901eb23e7&id=d87724dbea&e=8edd2b8f7d). Klayman had this to say when filing the class action complaint: “This case has the potential not just to yield large damages for the J-6 victims of the illegal surveillance by the Biden Department of Justice and its criminally minded attorney general and FBI director, but also to potentially knock out the prosecutions and convictions of J-6 peaceful protesters, as it appears that evidence was illegally obtained to use against them.” “Attorney General Merrick Garland, a pliant tool of the Democrat anti-Trump Left and President Biden himself, and his ‘lackey’ of an FBI Director Christopher Wray, have no respect for the constitutional rights of J-6 defendants and they will be made to pay a heavy price for their illegal actions.” “These two dishonest and corrupt ‘public servants’ have sadly turned my once proud alma mater, the U.S. Department of Justice, into a virtual Gestapo to put down all dissent against President Biden and his leftist comrades. This cannot be permitted to continue without legal recourse.” **For further information contact Asher Anderson at Asher.andersonfw@gmail.com**

name: Ilhan Omar
subject: The Brittany Clardy Missing And Murdered Black Women And Girls Act
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
This bill is not merely a piece of legislation — it's a beacon of hope for Black women and girls across the country.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=541%2E791427%2EzYJEA9)
Friends -
This past spring, my home state of Minnesota became the first to create a dedicated office for missing and murdered Black women, a trailblazing move that has since been replicated by states across the country.
For too long, Black women and girls have been disproportionately affected by an epidemic of violence, and it's long past time that we address this nationwide crisis at the federal level.
That's why earlier this week, I was proud to introduce the _Brittany Clardy Missing And Murdered Black Women And Girls Act_ in Congress — a critical piece of legislation which would establish a dedicated office within the Department of Justice and reaffirm our movement's commitment to valuing and protecting Black lives.
**[It's so important that our progressive movement stand together on this issue, which is why I'm asking you today: Can you add your voice to mine and say you support the _Brittany Clardy Missing And Murdered Black Women And Girls Act_ today?](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em230921-clardy-act/?source=em230921-1-t3&refcode2=541.791427.zYJEA9&akid=541%2E791427%2EzYJEA9)**
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em230921-clardy-act/?source=em230921-1-t3&refcode2=541.791427.zYJEA9&akid=541%2E791427%2EzYJEA9)**
Black women and girls in the United States are facing a violent crisis of unprecedented proportions, and yet remain overlooked, forgotten, and dismissed when it comes to discussions around violent crime.
The statistics here do not lie, and emphasize the incredible urgency of this legislation.
Last year, despite representing 7% of the population, a shocking 40% of missing women and girls in America were Black — 97,924 mothers, daughters, aunts, sisters, friends, and neighbors.
However, due to underreporting, mishandled investigations, and a lack of coordination among law enforcement agencies across state lines, so many of their stories remain untold, and so many of their cases remain unresolved.
This new office within the DoJ created by this bill will be responsible for conducting research, working with agencies at state, local, and tribal levels, and making policy recommendations to Congress that can help find concrete, real-world solutions to this ever-growing problem.
The truth is that a nationwide crisis of this scale and importance demands bold, urgent action. Which is why this bill is not merely a simple piece of legislation — it represents a beacon of hope for countless Black women, girls, and families across the country.
**As the mother of two beautiful Black girls, I am incredibly proud to lead this effort at the federal level, but I know that I cannot do it alone. So please:**
**[Add your name to say you support the _Brittany Clardy Missing And Murdered Black Women And Girls Act_ today. I would not ask if your support on this issue was not so incredibly important.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em230921-clardy-act/?source=em230921-1-t3&refcode2=541.791427.zYJEA9&akid=541%2E791427%2EzYJEA9)**
Thank you for reading, and thank you for signing on to our petition today.
In solidarity,
Ilhan

**We need your help!**
Judicial Watch has successfully launched investigations and lawsuits to expose Joe Biden's efforts to corruptly "weaponize" federal agencies to target, harass and attack groups and individuals who oppose Biden administration policies... _especially conservatives_!
These actions violate the law; they are frequently aided by Biden administration allies in the private sector; and they have damaged citizens' trust in the impartiality of our government.
**That 's why Judicial Watch's work exposing and fighting this unprecedented assault on the rule of law and Americans' First Amendment free speech rights is so important...and it is why [I hope I can count on you to help us with a special gift today!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65131&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)**

---

Here are just _four_ examples of Joe Biden's weaponization of government against conservatives and others who do not support his radical policy agenda.

* **Targeting and Investigating Parents Who Object to Critical Race Theory and other Left-wing Propaganda in their Childrens ' Schools **

* **Targeting and Investigating "Traditional" Catholics as "Potential Terrorists"**

* **Targeting and Indicting Former President Trump**

* **Conspiring with Big Tech to Silence Conservative Voices in Social Media**

Targeting and harassing political candidates and groups of law-abiding Americans because they oppose Joe Biden, and conspiring to censor social media, are a clear and present danger to the First Amendment and to the survival of our republic.

But while others complain about Biden lawlessness, Judicial Watch acts...through the legal system and the courts!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65131&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)
---

Thanks to the support of our members:

* Judicial Watch filed multiple FOIA lawsuits against the Justice Department and FBI for records related to Attorney General Garland's memo to law enforcement to "open dedicated lines of communication for threat reporting" about parent protests at school board meetings;

* We have filed a FOIA lawsuit, together with CatholicVote Civic Action, against the Justice Department and FBI for records about the FBI intelligence document that revealed FBI targeting of Catholics who support traditional Church beliefs, with plans to spy on Catholics in their churches and treat them as "potential terrorists."

* We were the first group to sue the Justice Department and the FBI for records related to the raid on Trump's Florida home;

* And we have led the way in forcing the release of documents exposing the alliance between federal government agencies and Big Tech related "content moderation" and outright censorship of conservative views on social media.

_We are doing_ the hard work that Congress and the liberal media _are not doing_ to expose the Biden administration's outright attacks on conservatives and on free speech rights...but [we need you to rejoin our team to keep the pressure on!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65131&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65131&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)

Joe Biden and his administration are pursuing a corruption of our government so profound and dangerous that it threatens America's survival as a democratic republic, and puts the First Amendment rights of every American at risk.

Judicial Watch's _continued success_ in amassing evidence of a clear pattern of using the federal government as a political tool to _punish_ opponents of the president (_and to cover-up evidence of_ _Biden family corruption_) is essential...and so is your support of all our work!

subject: Issue 1 Extreme & Dangerous!
body:
Ohio's November Issue 1 Ballot Initiative is Extreme & Dangerous! | | | [ ](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=b0aa013c14&e=5c740fa3e2)
---
| | |
**IMPORTANT MESSAGE FROM THE**

**OHIO FREEDOM ACTION NETWORK

(OhioFAN)

ABOUT NOVEMBER'S ISSUE 1!**

---
|
GFI is forwarding this message from the Executive Committee of the Ohio Freedom Action Network (OhioFAN) because it has a wealth of information on what you can do to help defeat November's Issue 1 ballot initiative. PLEASE READ & FORWARD TO EVERYONE YOU CAN! THANK YOU!

Greetings:

As you are no doubt aware, Issue 1 will be on the ballot on November 7th. Issue 1 is extreme and dangerous, and will erode parental rights and allow abortion to the day of birth. Many members of OhioFAN are interested in defeating Issue 1, and this email has helpful information to help you to get involved.

YARD SIGNS:

Protect Women Ohio, which is a consortium of many groups across Ohio, has purchased 150K yard signs for distribution throughout Ohio. Below is information on how you can access the yard signs and then help distribute them.

Central Ohio
Point of Contact: Cinda Alspaugh, Email: [Cinda@GCRTL.org](mailto:Cinda@GCRTL.org)

Northeast Ohio
Point of Contact: Sarah McGervey, email: [smcgervey@rtlofneo.com](mailto:smcgervey@rtlofneo.com)
Counties: Summit, Stark, Medina, Holmes, Portage, Wayne, Columbiana and Carroll

Cleveland, Ohio
Point of Contact: Kate Makra, Email: [kate@clevelandrighttolife.org](mailto:kate@clevelandrighttolife.org)
Counties: Cuyahoga, Lake, Lorain, Geauga, Ashtabula, Trumbull and Mahoning

Southwest Ohio
Point of Contact: Anne Marie Schmidt, Email: [aschmidt@cincinnatirighttolife.org](mailto:aschmidt@cincinnatirighttolife.org)
Counties: Butler, Warren, Hamilton, Clermont, Brown and Adams

Dayton, Ohio
Point of Contact: Margie Christie, Email: [mchristie@daytonlife.org](mailto:mchristie@daytonlife.org)
Counties: Montgomery, Greene, Clark, Champaign, Miami, Darke, Treble, Shelby, Van Wert, Paulding and Mercer

Northwest Ohio
Point of Contact: Ed Sitter, Email: [ed@grtl.org](mailto:ed@grtl.org)
Counties: Williams, Fulton, Lucas, Defiance, Henry, Wood, Ottawa, Sandusky, Erie and Huron

Findlay, Ohio
Point of Contact: Linda Theis, Email: [ljtheis@yahoo.com](mailto:ljtheis@yahoo.com)
Counties: Hancock, Putnam, Hardin, Richland, Seneca, Wyandot, and Crawford

Southeast Ohio
Point of Contact: Robbie Jacks
(740) 645-2565
Auditor & Gallia County Republican Central Committee chair

Medina County Republican Party
Point of contact: Tom Weyant - 330-603-8366

Mercer County Republican Party
For signs, message or text 419-305-2680

A&B Coffee Shop
501 S Broadway St. Greenville
M-F 7:30 am-2:00 pm
Saturday 8:00 am- noon

Dundee Grill
6836 OH-93 NW
Dundee, OH 44624

Lake County
Tom Hach: Text @ 216-650-7607

TRAINING: Learn how to talk about Issue 1 with friends, family and neighbors, Get Out the Vote (GOTV) and More:
* Pro-Life Campaign Closing – Turnout & Election Integrity – Tuesday, September 26 from 5:30 to 8:30 in Newbury, Ohio (Cleveland area). Click for more details: _[https://leadershipinstitute.org/training/school.cfm?schoolID=65531](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=511c0a3a59&e=5c740fa3e2)_

MORE TRAINING: i360 – Door Knocking Leader Training
* This training will cover the basics of the i360 app. You’ll learn how to use it for door knocking, how to make lists for anyone you recruit to do door knocking, etc.
* Please note: This training is for leaders, not individual volunteers. However, if you have one or more individuals you plan to have help out on an administrative level with your team, please feel free to invite them, as well.
* Sign up at: _[https://www.createdequal.org/i360/](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=75c47e465c&e=5c740fa3e2)_

PROTECT WOMEN OHIO ACTION: Paid and volunteer opportunities!
1. Paid canvassing- Earn $15-$20/ hour plus mileage, and people can set their own hours.

* * They visit homes of Pro-Life and persuadable Pro-Life voters with a simple survey that informs them why they should vote NO in November.
* Field Reps can work between 4-40 hours per week.

2. Volunteer* canvassing opportunities
3. Volunteer* phone calling

*If you prefer a volunteer position, Michelle will connect you with the team at Created Equal.

Contact: Michelle Ashley, State Director, Susan B Anthony Prolife America/Protect Women Ohio Action, 513.349.1955, [michelle@sbalistfield.org](mailto:michelle@sbalistfield.org)

TALKING POINTS: Here are some tips on engaging on Issue 1 with your friends, family and neighbors:
* * Promote the 'No' focus group talking points:
* Issue 1 is dangerous and extreme
* Issue 1 makes it legal in Ohio for a baby to be aborted up the Day of Birth for any eason
* Issue 1 takes away Parental Rights to make medical decisions for their children, including decisions about sex change surgeries
* Issue 1 removes important medical care protections for Ohio women by allowing non-certified individuals to perform important medical procedures on women

Thank you for taking the time to read through this, and please let me know if you have any questions.

IGWT,
Angie, Beth, Dan, Kirsten, Mary, Patty, Sandie and Tom
OhioFAN Executive Committee

Friend, I’m running to be Florida’s next U.S. Senator — and I hope you’ll give me a moment to share why.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70120015/428359934/1228502519?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk884-bu-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZjNjOWQ1My1hMDU4LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PhVrQg6QXCb-iwTzdO-3zT5pdnQuPy-mgBHpykueQNI=)
_My husband and three children._
I was born in Ecuador, and when I was 14, my mother brought my sisters and me to America in search of a better life.
We made a new home in a small, one room apartment in America. My mother worked double shifts as a home health care provider and at night, she took classes to learn English. When I was 15, I started picking up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help us make ends meet.
My mother’s hard work, incredible sacrifices, and relentlessly fierce hope made it possible for me to graduate college and become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress. She taught me that a better education, a better home, and a better future is always possible if we never give up. This is the promise of America.
**_And that’s why I’m running for Senate. Because Florida deserves better, and we’ve got to fight for it._**
Right now, our state is being pushed backward by far-right extremists like my opponent, Sen. Rick Scott. He’s targeting the most vulnerable amongst us, dividing our communities, and threatening the American dream. It’s no wonder why a mere 40% of Floridians view him favorably.
With experts saying Rick Scott is one of the most vulnerable senators up for reelection in 2024, I know that we can defeat him and restore the promise of America — but not without all hands on deck.

---
Hi Fellow Conservative,

I've been spending lots of time out on the campaign trail meeting thousands of inspiring Americans, so I'm reaching out to you today with the hope of us getting to know each other better. By the end of this email, after you've heard the story of where I come from, who I am, and why I'm running for President, if you're ready to join my team, I have something special I'd like to offer you. I'll start by telling you where I come from: My mom, a nurse, and dad, a box installer for Nielsen, moved across the Rust Belt before settling down in Florida, where I was born and raised. After I graduated high school, I worked to pay my way through Yale University as the Team Captain of our baseball team, and then went on to graduate from Harvard Law School. In those years, I aspired for a great career, but when I witnessed the horrific events of September 11th, 2001, nothing else mattered to me except volunteering to serve in our military to defend freedom--no matter the cost. Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.
