* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

subject: 🎙️ Cartels, Guns and Saying "NO!" to the kids
body:
👋 No Doubt About It Podcast Out Now! | | | | | |
---
[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=64fe983994&e=567664f14c)
In this brand new episode of No Doubt About It, **Mark and Krysty dive into some spicy discussions you won't want to miss.**
➡ [**STREAM EPISODE NOW**](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=d7102b835c&e=567664f14c)
* [Apple Podcasts](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=093ce20671&e=567664f14c)
* [Spotify](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=e12dff8ffa&e=567664f14c)
* [YouTube](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=0e84e71f3e&e=567664f14c)

They start by exploring the challenges Krysty faces as **she constantly overcommits to helping with the kids' school activities** , leaving her feeling overworked. Mark humorously encourages her to take a page from the guys' playbook and consider not overcommitting by sitting out every opportunity to help possible, sparking a ...“lively” conversation.
| | | | | | | | | [](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=6e957c0507&e=567664f14c)
---
The podcast takes a turn as Mark and Krysty discuss the media's increasing scrutiny of Joe Biden's ability to run for reelection due to concerns about his mental state. It's a segment that delves into the current reality that everyone with eyes can clearly see. **Joe is no longer capable of being President of the United States.**
| [STREAM EPISODE NOW](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=ea5b320f1f&e=567664f14c)
---
But that's not all! In this episode, we are joined by a special guest, Reve Swainston, a former federal prosecutor. Reve shares his concerns about **Governor Michelle Lujan Grisham's recent gun ban** , emphasizing the importance of upholding constitutional rights. He also offers valuable insights into tackling the crime problem in Albuquerque, advocating for keeping violent criminals behind bars as opposed to the lax Democratic policies that, he believes, are putting innocent lives at risk.
| [STREAM EPISODE NOW](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=303b88646c&e=567664f14c)
---
The conversation concludes with Mark and Reve discussing the consequences of the Biden administration's open border policy, which is **allowing drug cartels to gain an alarming foothold in our communities.**
➡ [**STREAM EPISODE NOW**](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=10e5e3f94e&e=567664f14c)
[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=061056cc4d&e=567664f14c)
# SUPPORT NO DOUBT ABOUT IT
We invite you to listen, enjoy, and engage with this thought-provoking episode of the No Doubt About It Podcast. Don't forget to **like, listen, and subscribe to the podcast on your favorite platform** , and check us out on YouTube for video content.
And, if you're a fan of the podcast, visit our store at [nodoubtaboutitpodcast.com](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=85f1427b8a&e=567664f14c) to grab some fantastic No Doubt About It Podcast gear. Your support helps us keep the great content coming.
Thank you for being a part of our podcast community. We can't wait for you to hear this episode and share your thoughts with us.

Warm regards,Mark and Krysty Ronchetti

Peter, Whenever I do press or interviews, I always get asked the same question: “ _Would you ever consider running for Congress again?”_ And my honest answer is: I don’t know. But I think they’re asking the wrong question. The question they should be asking is: “ _How can you make an impact outside of Congress?”_ The reality is I’m not in Congress right now. That doesn’t mean my work for women, working families, and young people is over. There are so many ways to make a difference without standing on the House floor — that’s why I started HER Time. HER Time is supporting the women and young people running for office who are often overlooked and underfunded. We’re advocating for issues important to us and our families, policies that don’t get support from corporate lobbyists or super PACs, but will make a real difference in our lives. My time in Congress was always about so much more than just me or my seat. It was about making an impact. Now I get to do that with HER Time — so asking if I’ll run for office again really isn’t the most important question. body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70121704/428366094/-531765509?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NTE3NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYmQ3YjQ4Mi1hNDU4LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9EgQDFXvKup4JNfQqxRryKdg6U0xqDg6T3RltGqFbrs=&emci=0c9b7fef-c257-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=1bd7b482-a458-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=10203249) Hey friend – today is National Opioid Awareness Day, so I want to start with one simple message: **If you, or anyone you know, is suffering from substance use disorder, call 1-800-662-HELP to get help now.** The prescription opioid and heroin overdose epidemic affects Pennsylvanians across the commonwealth, from big cities to rural communities. As Auditor General, I released a report on the impact of fentanyl overdoses in Pennsylvania – and made ten recommendations to help minimize harm and save lives, including improving access to naloxone, making fentanyl test strips legal, and connecting people suffering from addiction with trained recovery specialists. **But the work to confront this crisis is far from over. And I promise you I’ll work day in and day out to make progress, because this fight is personal to me too.** Listen, my dad was injured in Vietnam, and battled addiction when he got back. He got hooked on painkillers, which eventually led to a ten-and-a-half-year prison sentence. But I’ve also seen my dad get sober, and defeat addiction. So I know this battle intimately, and I understand that it’s not easy. I’ll bring that personal experience with me as your next Attorney General. I’ll be a leader who truly understands what real people facing addiction are up against, and what it’s like for their families and loved ones. You can trust me to have your back. I know this crisis won’t be solved overnight – but as your next Attorney General, I’m going to do everything I can to protect Pennsylvanians in every corner of our Commonwealth. Thank you for taking the time to read this and for supporting a mission that's personal to so many of us. – Eugene | | [DONATE →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70121712/428366115/-412144306?refcode=email_092123_Opioids&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NTE3NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYmQ3YjQ4Mi1hNDU4LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9EgQDFXvKup4JNfQqxRryKdg6U0xqDg6T3RltGqFbrs=)

subject: Can I share something personal with you?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOANNA WEISS FOR CONGRESS
body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70123054/428369398/-1695430967?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDU2NTciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDFiZmFhZmUtYTc1OC1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=kHuV8DU6Fw_K5bysf_Blw8dwFzE61IjN3yc4bu5ZvyY=)
Peter, I am so honored that my parents took the time to write you last week. So right now, can I share something personal with you?

Today is a special day for my family. 55 years ago today, my parents were married!
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70123055/428369401/-129347026?refcode=em-9.21.23-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDU2NTciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDFiZmFhZmUtYTc1OC1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=kHuV8DU6Fw_K5bysf_Blw8dwFzE61IjN3yc4bu5ZvyY=)
_My mom and dad on their wedding day, September 21, 1968._
My parents instilled in me the values of hard work and the importance of family in all of the choices they made. I carry these lessons with me and have passed them on to my own three children.

[In honor of their anniversary, I hope you will chip in $3 today toward my campaign for CA-47. It is partly thanks to my parents’ dedication to our family and to Orange County that I felt so inspired to run for office.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70123056/428369402/-129347026?refcode=em-9.21.23-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDU2NTciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDFiZmFhZmUtYTc1OC1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=kHuV8DU6Fw_K5bysf_Blw8dwFzE61IjN3yc4bu5ZvyY=)

It wasn’t easy for my family. My father served in the U.S. Navy, and after he was honorably discharged, my family struggled to make ends meet when he faced unemployment. We were using food stamps, on Medicaid, and my parents used a VA loan to purchase our first family home.

**My mother worked as a public school teacher for children with special needs, and my father was a military veteran -- together, they modeled a life of service to my brother (who attended the U.S. Naval Academy) and me. Their service to our communities was part of what ultimately pushed me to run for office myself.**

They are so proud to have lived in Orange County for most of their lives together, and it is so special to me to be running for office where I grew up.

Today, my parents are a steadfast influence in my life. You can often find my mother with me on the campaign trail, going door to door to help elect Democrats across the state.

[I hope you will chip in $3 today toward my campaign for CA-47. They taught me from an early age to serve my community, and I couldn’t be more grateful.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70123057/428369403/-129347026?refcode=em-9.21.23-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDU2NTciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDFiZmFhZmUtYTc1OC1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=kHuV8DU6Fw_K5bysf_Blw8dwFzE61IjN3yc4bu5ZvyY=)

clean_body: | = Peter, I am so honored that my parents took the time to write you last week. So right now, can I share something personal with you? Today is a special day for my family. 55 years ago today, my parents were married! = My mom and dad on their wedding day, September 21, 1968. My parents instilled in me the values of hard work and the importance of family in all of the choices they made. I carry these lessons with me and have passed them on to my own three children. = It wasn’t easy for my family. My father served in the U.S. Navy, and after he was honorably discharged, my family struggled to make ends meet when he faced unemployment. We were using food stamps, on Medicaid, and my parents used a VA loan to purchase our first family home. My mother worked as a public school teacher for children with special needs, and my father was a military veteran -- together, they modeled a life of service to my brother (who attended the U.S. Naval Academy) and me. Their service to our communities was part of what ultimately pushed me to run for office myself. They are so proud to have lived in Orange County for most of their lives together, and it is so special to me to be running for office where I grew up. Today, my parents are a steadfast influence in my life. You can often find my mother with me on the campaign trail, going door to door to help elect Democrats across the state. = In unity, Joanna | **=** | Joanna's campaign doesn't take a dime from corporate PACs and completely relies on grassroots supporters like you! Hi Peter,

I've been spending lots of time out on the campaign trail meeting thousands of inspiring Americans, so I'm reaching out to you today with the hope of us getting to know each other better. By the end of this email, after you've heard the story of where I come from, who I am, and why I'm running for President, if you're ready to join my team, I have something special I'd like to offer you. I'll start by telling you where I come from: My mom, a nurse, and dad, a box installer for Nielsen, moved across the Rust Belt before settling down in Florida, where I was born and raised. After I graduated high school, I worked to pay my way through Yale University as the Team Captain of our baseball team, and then went on to graduate from Harvard Law School. In those years, I aspired for a great career, but when I witnessed the horrific events of September 11th, 2001, nothing else mattered to me except volunteering to serve in our military to defend freedom--no matter the cost. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

body:
Small towns should never be left behind

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70124746/428375095/-1807168276?refcode=wrpr_hdr&ms=230921_cd_smalltown&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZWM2OTdkNS1hOTU4LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jFjInTnNyqJbutisdvgLFBjcFQrkR6WZD6BNebMh3P4=)
---
Hi Derek, I grew up in a small borough in Western PA, where we have so many great close-knit communities and main streets. Every day, I talk with voters who are worried that their communities are being left behind. Today, I want to spotlight just one of those towns: Ambridge in Beaver County, PA. Ambridge is part of the district I serve in Congress, and it's also a prime example of how small towns in Western PA built America. Ambridge was a steel town, where the American Bridge plant employed thousands of workers and built a strong community. American Bridge **workers made some of the most famous bridges and buildings in the world** – the Verrazano Narrows Bridge in New York, the San Francisco-Oakland Bay Bridge, the Empire State Building, and the Sears Tower. But when lousy trade deals shipped steel production overseas, jobs and businesses in the community dried up. At its height, Ambridge supported over 20,000 people. Now, the population has more than halved. **It's a story that thousands of people in Western PA have felt. That story needs to end here.** We should be making sh*t here, in Western PA, and making it with union workers. Towns like Ambridge never agreed to ship jobs overseas or make Wall Street and foreign companies rich at our expense. [_**Will you join my campaign to fight for small towns like Ambridge, invest in American workers, and bring back strong union jobs that will support our families – not corporate jagoffs?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70124750/428375097/-1807168276?refcode=230921_cd_smalltown_l1&ms=230921_cd_smalltown&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZWM2OTdkNS1hOTU4LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jFjInTnNyqJbutisdvgLFBjcFQrkR6WZD6BNebMh3P4=) **[Chip in](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70124753/428375099/-1807168276?refcode=230921_cd_smalltown_b1&ms=230921_cd_smalltown&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZWM2OTdkNS1hOTU4LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jFjInTnNyqJbutisdvgLFBjcFQrkR6WZD6BNebMh3P4=)** Thank you for joining me in fighting for small towns in Western PA and all across America, Derek. – Chris Deluzio

He'll be a champion for our unions, fight to guarantee good healthcare for every American, take on corporate power, and advocate for bold action to protect and strengthen our democracy. Friend,
While big corporations and greedy bad actors try to take advantage of you, it’s my job as the People’s Lawyer to have your back.
Right-wing special interests and corporations that value advancing their own ideological agendas and profiteering over people aren’t big fans of me. That’s why they spent millions of dollars to try to beat me last year.

I’m running for U.S. Senate because our country needs leaders who will stand up for our service members and take action against threats to our national security — not another politician who’s obsessed with using their own power to put the livelihoods of everyday, working people across our country in jeopardy. I’m building this campaign without a cent from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or defense contractors, so you’ll know I’ll always keep my oath to you. But I need your help to keep growing our grassroots movement. So Peter: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: Thank you, Lucas Kunce | | Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

With Jim Walsh as the new State Party Chair, we are going to implement these same strategies statewide, and Republicans are going to start winning...

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

Hi there, It's Wendy, from the Kaptur for Congress Finance Team. I'm writing to share a behind-the-scenes update since our critical quarterly fundraising deadline is just 9 days away. Most campaigns keep their internal fundraising data under lock and key. But we don't view our supporters as an ATM. We know you're our partners, our friends and neighbors, who share in our vision for a better future for America's Heartland. So we believe in being transparent with you. And the truth is, friend, right now we are falling behind. Take a look at this graph from our fundraising dashboard: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70133284/428386782/1037629634?refcode=230921_wb_midmonth_img&ms=230921_wb_midmonth&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTY1NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYjJkYTllYy1iMTU4LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7yMwcioBcA16iVe8GTK8yCKsskBnZ8a_ynOwFVi2a6g=) We have a lot of ground to make up to reach our end-of-the-quarter goal. And with the national GOP targeting our race, we're going to need all of the resources we can muster to defend our district. **Friend, we have made huge strides for the Heartland in the past few years. Under my leadership, the Maryland Women’s Legislative Caucus took an official position to prioritize advancing reproductive rights for the first time in 40 years. And we passed legislation protecting the rights of every person with a uterus in our state so that patients traveling from restrictive places like West Virginia can get comprehensive care — including abortion care — when they need it.
Going toe-to-toe with the corporate gun lobby and winning? I’ve done that too, and I'm proud to say it was with tireless community advocates working by my side every step of the way. It took four years of hard work and bipartisan collaboration, but we passed the bill to ban the sale, transfer, and possession of unserialized handguns or “ghost guns” here in Maryland.
I'm running for Congress in the competitive open seat here in MD-06 because we need more leaders in Congress who know how to pass legislation like this that benefits all of us.
But make no mistake, this highly competitive open seat will be one that National Republicans work to flip red. It’s up to us to do everything we can to keep it blue and elect a tough, proven woman leader with a real record of results to change the face of Maryland’s all-male federal delegation.
So can I count on you to give what you can to our people-powered campaign's end-of-quarter goal so we can keep organizing across this big diverse district? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamlesley_email?refcode2=link_CTA2]
Every donation makes a huge difference!
- Lesley
Lesley Lopez is a Democrat running for the open competitive seat in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District. When she’s not busy being a mom to her two toddlers, Lesley Lopez serves the people of Maryland as a Delegate from District 39 in the Maryland General Assembly. Since she was first elected in 2018, Lesley has rapidly become an effective legislator and leader, spearheading efforts to alleviate student debt, improve the delivery and efficiency of health care, and protect the limited financial resources of economically vulnerable Marylanders. Lesley has passed legislation to strengthen gun safety laws and guarantee the rights for all women in the state. She is an adjunct professor at George Washington University and a proud union member of SEIU Local 500. Lesley lives in Germantown, MD, with her husband Richard Kelly, and their two sons, Max and Graham.

Hi Fellow Conservative,

I've been spending lots of time out on the campaign trail meeting thousands of inspiring Americans, so I'm reaching out to you today with the hope of us getting to know each other better. By the end of this email, after you've heard the story of where I come from, who I am, and why I'm running for President, if you're ready to join my team, I have something special I'd like to offer you. I'll start by telling you where I come from: My mom, a nurse, and dad, a box installer for Nielsen, moved across the Rust Belt before settling down in Florida, where I was born and raised. After I graduated high school, I worked to pay my way through Yale University as the Team Captain of our baseball team, and then went on to graduate from Harvard Law School. In those years, I aspired for a great career, but when I witnessed the horrific events of September 11th, 2001, nothing else mattered to me except volunteering to serve in our military to defend freedom--no matter the cost. Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Friend,

**Nicole Malliotakis here.**

**THE BIDEN IMPEACHMENT INQUIRY IS OFFICIAL.**

My good friend and Speaker of the House of Representatives, Kevin McCarthy, has announced an impeachment inquiry into Joe Biden and his corrupt dealings. House Republicans have uncovered **SERIOUS** allegations into Biden's conduct. There's no doubt that a culture of corruption surrounds Joe Biden, and **AMERICANS DESERVE BETTER.**

1\. He **lied** about his own knowledge of his families foreign business dealings.

2\. Bank records show that **nearly $20M in payments** were directed to the Biden family through different shell companies - many flagged as "suspicious" by U.S. banks.

Friend,
Last week, a conservative federal judge in Texas struck down the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) program — the same judge who reached the same decision back in 2021.
**This decision is absolutely unacceptable and threatens the futures of hundreds of thousands of young people who came to this country as children and grew up as Americans. Congress must take immediate action.**
The Dream Act of 2023 (S. 365) would finally provide Dreamers, Temporary Protected Status holders, and Deferred Enforced Departure recipients a path to citizenship and protect them from being torn away from their jobs and families.

The Dream Act of 2023 (S. 365) would finally provide Dreamers, Temporary Protected Status holders, and Deferred Enforced Departure recipients a path to citizenship and protect them from being torn away from their jobs and families. "CTA Button" DACA gave undocumented young people much-deserved autonomy and peace. They should be able to keep it. In solidarity, NextGen America | NextGen America 268 Bush St. #2919 San Francisco CA 94104-3503 This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com | =

#### CTA #1: How to File an Open Records Request
If you’re looking for specific government information, filing a request for Open Records can often lead you to the answers you seek. For our first Call to Action (CTA), we’re encouraging all Open Records newbies to try filing a request.
If you’ve filed ORRs or FOIAs in the past, then you get a pass on this first CTA 😀. But, if you haven’t, we highly encourage you to take a few minutes and flex your Open Record Request muscles. Citizen engagement is essential for good government. Don’t be a spectator, get in the game!
[We’ve posted a short how-to on our website. You can find it by clicking here](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/Qvk83lMrxpyahZ2UDrJlsUUkzv6S5IbZaiCcmLVvdD8HxQF0y7nuS8RvHg2q7iq6e82sW-pAprWeUyr73fDDF_7YBUjoKmC1M8UKDKhiSWgy4R0KUaJksYS31NhwU5slFsEv4GGOKw86WTO09rc6yVeCaIiGcnJG9ZuRKy-dijvmroaYOGOoZxeeg7n8IR7_em27DxSXRmPj7UX5lX4M0am0DHo8BWM9du5bOLxwHfZXFVOftVkxwWn7oiHYvtMFodh9d5QpfTDYiEgr_C5aRCw72unZiWG9u7tPi-j5TwU/3zs/jLQt_HDqTCaMZfMPjpL8fg/h1/uJOyxO-cIwTHOHSHptB12U1Q1QMyk9rHc41MEm3hOoA).
|

Be sure to check out the **Quick References** section, featuring links that will take you directly to **databases of state specific rules, sample letters, and federal guidelines for FOIAs.**(We also came across the [DOJ’s list of FOIA exclusions](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/Qvk83lMrxpyahZ2UDrJlsYExwSk7T-TnZrIVs4KUJVhoNFQkpafIg1uiW6yTsOXJ8knel-VWRQosz7DdpSJifTM2fSJJ9etjHjc9d_eVs76R5Em9-0ypuOlxq1edhceR3WHdfAlZs7u_co_jDgMPeKcDYxPYEEIF-G5T3xhSa5kTdCdH3CqWhjPAdXgfNTqvbdrbLtzvwHmJOlUyNxzluixWoKWlcjO0CKTs054V4D3ahVhp6NjIIMXg2Cg4zERI/3zs/jLQt_HDqTCaMZfMPjpL8fg/h2/wxoizGhTB_h__MPG2k87ftJ--Km78uvpbT-K78pzqE4), which is a really interesting read.)
If you don’t have a question in mind, here are some ideas:
* Submit a request to your local election administrator or secretary of state asking for digital copies of all election complaints filed from January 1, 2020 to present.
* Submit a request to your city council asking for digital copies of annual budgets.
* Submit a request to any agency of interest asking for a digital log of all other open records requests or FOIAs submitted in whatever date range you specify.

There are many organizations focused on filing FOIAs (and suing if the data isn’t released). So I was honored when Politico acknowledged me as one of the top climate power brokers in California. = = | **= The article notes: “Friedman has focused on the intersection of transportation and climate as the chair of the Assembly Transportation Committee. She’s been instrumental in the push for wildlife crossings and aligning transportation spending with state climate goals... She’s also passed bills addressing toxic chemicals and water conservation.” That doesn’t even include having used my time in the legislature to put California on a path to phase out single-use plastics and reduce greenhouse gas emissions in our buildings by 40 percent over the next decade! I will always be uncompromising in my commitment to combating the climate crisis and building sustainable, healthy methods of transportation for our people. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=1603%2E120351%2EdupWbs)
Peter,
Fox News’ destructive influence over right-wing politics is undeniable. We saw it in 2020 when they pushed Donald Trump’s “big lie.” The result was the January 6th riot and a majority of Republican voters now believing Democrats rigged the 2020 election for Joe Biden.

In their latest gambit to pump up ratings and help Trump, Fox News led the charge for an impeachment inquiry _**without evidence of any wrongdoing by President Biden.**_
Speaker of the House Kevin McCarthy eventually caved to the pressure. The first impeachment hearing is now scheduled for September 28th, just two days before a possible government shutdown that, you guessed it, Fox News is cheerleading now as well...
We’ll keep explaining below, but first:**[Courier was created to call out BS from bad actors like Fox News. We deliver the truth to the communities who need it most, all without paywalls. If you’re sick of Fox News hurting our democracy, will you chip in $5 and support our mission today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230921?refcode=em20230921&amount=5&refcode2=1603_120351_dupWbs&akid=1603%2E120351%2EdupWbs)**
**So here’s the latest on Fox News’ latest grift – the looming government shutdown:**
The House needs to pass 12 appropriation bills by the end of September to avoid a government shutdown. With just 10 days left before the deadline, Fox News hosts like Sean Hannity are telling far-right extremists in Congress (and the millions of voters they represent) to “take a stand” and shut down the government.
If they listen, hundreds of thousands could be furloughed, essential government services could be delayed, and our already fragile economy will take another severe blow.
**So here’s the deal: from climate denialism to amplifying Trump’s “big lie,” Fox News is spreading dangerous misinformation and damaging American democracy. We can fight back and correct the record, but that takes serious resources. That’s where you come in.**

Hi Peter,

I've been spending lots of time out on the campaign trail meeting thousands of inspiring Americans, so I'm reaching out to you today with the hope of us getting to know each other better. By the end of this email, after you've heard the story of where I come from, who I am, and why I'm running for President, if you're ready to join my team, I have something special I'd like to offer you. I'll start by telling you where I come from: My mom, a nurse, and dad, a box installer for Nielsen, moved across the Rust Belt before settling down in Florida, where I was born and raised. After I graduated high school, I worked to pay my way through Yale University as the Team Captain of our baseball team, and then went on to graduate from Harvard Law School. In those years, I aspired for a great career, but when I witnessed the horrific events of September 11th, 2001, nothing else mattered to me except volunteering to serve in our military to defend freedom--no matter the cost. I deployed to Iraq with the U.S. Navy as a Judge Advocate General's Corps (JAG) Officer in support of SEAL Team 1, and it was the honor of my life to serve alongside fellow patriots, proudly wearing the cloth of my country as a badge of honor on our uniforms.
---
| [](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=b48762ddf5ae4d409b0935ba1c631c61&_e=BADBOXPAhYb_HId8HR6RZyLeTjr9G6kkIUPotZ-o7Lz0pCJSxLF9Eo1Sd95ckhVVqf2NaTX197nD7sLuY6hcXZIp93nWq8wZH_dSJyO3kpIMynIp2W0sYFwKqiJRWu9l5DpfNFfmZxf1MY4LZxybULZLwSpIS-lj9C9jbWy3UlPOryVWM52nHNx1Wj34zFZqc4ISdAP-fzgfxdp49mqlheDL1tajYp4XHWcw5MHScNJfjMzmn7UUQdz2ITaXq3AL5DDa-Th4lo3xlaO2dFB8m6Wnxg-ebdHWAva4gZwE_TGRue1LMaDR4q7HI3vkJp7CmlYBlFWAvjL35tB573hrv60sihcm3PLHcG9wHDv280qWpQER9TwkTNjNtkSu-JiO5oQZOa5K1gjJWEQOrkdLnSIgaULoVpMAhs7VNmcN1ijBvV2SMc0DAQyyXidS80_j)
---
After my time in the service, I felt compelled to continue fighting for what's right and standing up for causes bigger than myself, and I've since been blessed to serve my community as a Congressman and now Governor of Florida. During my term as Governor, our nation was faced with COVID-19, and this pandemic exposed just how much leadership matters. It proved that our nation is in decline because elected leaders have lacked the necessary qualities to stay strong, fight for the people they serve, and chart a different course even if it goes against the grain of public opinion. In Florida, we showed that it can be done--success IS attainable--and I've let my record speak for itself. Two more titles I'm proud to hold are husband to my incredible wife Casey--the best First Lady I believe this state has ever seen--and father to my 6-, 5-, and 3-year-olds. As a father, I'm having to watch the radical Left shove a political agenda down parents' and kids' throats at every turn. They're having to face lies that men can get pregnant and that we should embrace feelings of hate and guilt instead of pride in our country. At this rate, if we don't make a change, we are facing the reality where we become the first generation to leave our children with a worse America than we inherited.
---
| [](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=b48762ddf5ae4d409b0935ba1c631c61&_e=BADBOXPAhYb_HId8HR6RZyLeTjr9G6kkIUPotZ-o7Lz0pCJSxLF9Eo1Sd95ckhVVqf2NaTX197nD7sLuY6hcXZIp93nWq8wZH_dSJyO3kpIMynIp2W0sYFwKqiJRWu9l5DpfNFfmZxf1MY4LZxybULZLwSpIS-lj9C9jbWy3UlPOryVWM52nHNx1Wj34zFZqc4ISdAP-fzgfxdp49mqlheDL1tajYp4XHWcw5MHScNJfjMzmn7UUQdz2ITaXq3AL5DDa-Th4lo3xlaO2dFB8m6Wnxg-ebdHWAva4gZwE_THj_DAkpkUduKyWdJH4xEWFNyVFBBWgWel3d4CO7lLoBWY3lMiHYfB2rr3qUnehqUbbGXqEXHPeWRg-VXd1wZAJ7UCx1XHcDKrTFpEDvnX6MSLIDEcnhcAtAei1jNcNs9gA0T8TQx0gunIocc8uF96N)
---
But, Peter, we do not have to accept this decline. It CAN be reversed, and I believe we have a responsibility to step up and do it. This cannot wait another four years. If you share this belief in a better tomorrow with me, I am humbly asking you to join my team. You should know that every dollar counts in this race, and every contribution to my team goes so much farther than you could know. That's why, if you join my team by making any donation of just $5 or more, I want to welcome you with a free bumper sticker.
---

While we put your contribution to good use out on the trail--reaching new voters, hosting big events, producing all kinds of merchandise, advertising across the country, building our network, raising the resources we need to keep going--you could be making an even bigger impact by spreading the word right where you are. I have made it my mission to always lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. With your help, we won't lose. We will reverse the decline of this country and get the job done. You'll see very quickly I'm not like anyone else in this race. In the state of Florida, everything I promised we would do, we've gotten done, and then some, when's the last time anybody you've elected has over-delivered on their promises? As your next President, I promise I'll do the same thing. It's time for the Republican party to buck this culture of losing. You can count on me, Peter. I hope I can count on you.

In Freedom

clean_body: It's happening. | = | Hi Peter, I never thought I’d be able to share a (metaphoric) stage with Taylor Swift, but the world is a weird place. Here's what happened: It was supposed to be a big week for our campaign because it was National Voter Registration Day. Our team hoped to register 100 new voters. Then something wild happened... Swift posted on her Instagram about National Voter Registration Day and 13,000 new voters were registered... every 30 minutes! Needless to say, we blew through our 100 new voters goal. It was wild. = So here’s why this is such a big deal: 8 million young people will be eligible to vote in 2024. This new generation of voters is vital in a toss-up district like mine. If we engage with these young people early, they will be involved in the democratic process. If we ignore them, we risk losing them into the ether of “why vote, it doesn’t matter.” I refuse to let that happen. We know that our path to victory in the Central Valley is through strong voter turnout. Democrats win when people are registered to vote. We lose when people become disengaged and disheartened. That’s why I’ve directed my team to focus on registering young voters (including young voters of color!) who are too often disenfranchised from politics. We’re showing up to people's doors, college campuses, coffee shops, you name it, with clipboards and registration forms. We know that when we engage young people on issues like climate change or reproductive rights, they realize how important it is to vote. But we need your help (and I guess Taylor Swift’s...) to make it happen. We have 12 weeks before ballots go out in our first election against our GOP opponent.= If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your payment will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- Your fellow Swiftie, \- Josh *

Joe Kent

subject: Your Signature is Needed: We’re so close to stopping Arctic drilling
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2002142?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | You may have noticed it yourself Friend, for most places across the globe **this has been the HOTTEST summer on record!** For many, the heat is nearly unbearable. _**And it’s only getting hotter.**_ In places where the cold climate is necessary for the ecosystem to thrive, the record beating heat can only be even more harmful. For the vulnerable polar bears in the Arctic, the rising temperature could only increase the rate to their **_EXTINCTION._** Meanwhile, Big Oil wants the precious Arctic land for fossil fuel projects that fill their dirty pockets. Drilling and fracking only increases the rate of global warming, resulting in melting ice caps. The growth of oil drilling and fracking activity will also drive away **critical food sources,** disrupt **bear denning sites,** and could even **impair polar bear survival mechanisms,** such as their ability to feed, hunt, and tend to their baby bear cubs. This is _**URGENT**_ \-- if the Arctic continues to warm at the current rate, experts predict it could be **completely ice-free as early as 2054!** As you read this, the Biden Administration is proposing regulations to prohibit oil drilling and fracking on Arctic lands. We need YOU to use your voice in supporting these regulations. [**The existence of these beloved creatures now falls on us, Friend! Will you fight back with us and PROTECT vulnerable polar bears by taking action NOW? >>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2002143?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2002144?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
The Arctic is home to not only polar bears and other wildlife, but to Indigenous communities who rely on the land, water, and the ecosystem’s fragile balance for resources. Reckless oil drilling and fracking disturbs this balance by poisoning water sources and driving away fish. Residents nearby also suffer from **noise pollution and toxic greenhouse emissions** from industrial-sized drilling machines.
The National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) was created to protect communities, animals and the planet from environmentally destructive activities that could cause irreparable harm. Under NEPA, the current drilling and fracking on Arctic lands do not only violate these protections but infringes on the communities’ input to protect their homes and quality of life. _People, polar bears, and the entire Arctic ecosystem are at risk if we do not protect them._
**[Please, Friend, we need environmentalists like you to speak up for people and the planet. Sign the petition to SAVE the Arctic and the planet from Big Oil’s corporate greed >>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2002145?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**

Friends of the Earth**

Growing up, I never thought about “party” or “partisanship.” It just wasn’t something my parents (both lifelong Republicans) talked about. That’s why I spent nearly thirty years as a special education teacher — to make sure kids who needed an advocate in school had one. 2. **We are fighting for the future of our country.** So much is at stake – our jobs, safe schools, health care, abortion rights, civil rights, and the future of our planet. The privileged and powerful have rigged our politics and our economy for their own benefit and are pouring dark money into our elections to maintain control. We need to work together to build a massive blue wave to overcome their money, their lobbyists, their voter suppression, and their gerrymandered districts.

If we start organizing now, we'll be able to outperform all expectations in 2024. The race for control of the Senate will be tight – Republicans only need to flip two seats to win control, and we need to fight with everything we've got to make sure that doesn't happen. Here's what I want you to know about the 2024 election and how it will determine who is in the Senate Majority: 1. Winning races in battleground states like Montana, Pennsylvania, Nevada, Ohio, and Wisconsin requires significant resources and early investments to make sure voters hear our message of progress and opportunity for all. If we fall short on any of our goals – even this far out – Republicans could take the lead in these must-win Senate seats. 2. We are fighting for the future of our country. So much is at stake – our jobs, safe schools, health care, abortion rights, civil rights, and the future of our planet. The privileged and powerful have rigged our politics and our economy for their own benefit and are pouring dark money into our elections to maintain control. We need to work together to build a massive blue wave to overcome their money, their lobbyists, their voter suppression, and their gerrymandered districts. If we start organizing now, we'll be able to outperform all expectations in 2024. With early support from people like you, we'll be more than ready to defend key Senate incumbents like Sherrod Brown, Bob Casey, Jon Tester, Jacky Rosen, and Tammy Baldwin and keep America moving forward. = Onward! body:

subject: My most important roles
body:
Hey team, You may know me best as Maryland’s 63rd governor. I’m also a combat veteran, author, former CEO of one of the nation’s largest anti-poverty organizations, and a Rhodes Scholar. But by far the most important roles I hold are husband to my First and forever Lady Dawn, and dad to Mia and James. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70141904/428410355/976100070?refcode=em20230921&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNTc3MmY2OS1jYTU4LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_c1iTAFlCJhAD-sKABSfTvWSjVpFRtgzouJ11EFmCa4=) Seeing my mom raise our family on her own after my dad’s passing, and now raising Mia and James here with Dawn, I know first-hand just how hard families in this state work to get by — and that’s the reason I decided to run for Governor in the first place. **In our last eight months in office, I’m proud to say we’ve shown that Maryland can do big things for families in our state.** → We’ve passed the Fair Wage Act, raising the minimum wage and creating an economic cushion for over 150,000 Maryland families.
→ We created programs to end child poverty that will lift over 37,000 Maryland children to the next rung of the economic ladder.
→ We signed gun safety laws to protect our communities from gun violence.
→ We’ve created a first-in-the-country program offering a paid year of service for high school graduates, to empower and give purpose to the next generation. And of course, no matter how hard our administration works, I’m never too busy to play football in the front yard of Government House with my kids and share family dinners on Saturday nights. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70141906/428410357/976100070?refcode=em20230921&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNTc3MmY2OS1jYTU4LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_c1iTAFlCJhAD-sKABSfTvWSjVpFRtgzouJ11EFmCa4=) That’s because in our home in the Government House, and across the state of Maryland, family is everything. Family is the reason we get up in the morning, overcome tough challenges, and work together to build the state our children deserve. [**If you’re ready to join the fight for a stronger Maryland, add a contribution today to support our efforts. With your support, I can keep working to lighten burdens and create opportunities for all Marylanders and their families. **](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70141907/428410358/976100070?refcode=em20230921&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNTc3MmY2OS1jYTU4LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_c1iTAFlCJhAD-sKABSfTvWSjVpFRtgzouJ11EFmCa4=) | [Contribute »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70141909/428410359/976100070?refcode=em20230921&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNTc3MmY2OS1jYTU4LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_c1iTAFlCJhAD-sKABSfTvWSjVpFRtgzouJ11EFmCa4=)

body:
Here’s a few things you may not know about me. See here why I’d like you on my team and how I’ll thank you when you join!
---

| | | | [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=786c020c7dc041069a15c19075eba951&_e=mye8uEPi_tZ2IizkHB5UK1k4HQKNjYuodsy6SbsxP7mzJw9mX9JgfJaZvaoVIxt9U6Xdd3Lri3wEOtve5kf9qFHTJR-HifLy7wPnpxenv9hYay_NQMsoZTxIAXn5vknE12o-dAzes8zKHyb9dUtwIJAQicPfWVKc7yV8wczFf6EQBrfB05vDfYfDoI9I_usNvi8plJcVAccMePMPaqKRB6MHW5T0EyXN1BbEUcr53FtHYdLue8epbgr3CIRFnIr50SGPSWjPVYFs4sF1QklPWnu0dYCVpp90jOxrgKQ4iqwChSF0a-va46AbY4DSSsamEhDKXhZD36M_Hgw66BzmjpTUGJ2QyPbEVGpwdxWQZmOl6IM5FI_wPJyot5TdiokqqJeoN0L_7vWG1QpYwfE7Wo2GA7CILSj_xUGjTqdTZNOOO3EQWSz0TX_SGunP7yxl)
---
Hi Peter,

I've been spending lots of time out on the campaign trail meeting thousands of inspiring Americans, so I'm reaching out to you today with the hope of us getting to know each other better. By the end of this email, after you've heard the story of where I come from, who I am, and why I'm running for President, if you're ready to join my team, I have something special I'd like to offer you. I'll start by telling you where I come from: My mom, a nurse, and dad, a box installer for Nielsen, moved across the Rust Belt before settling down in Florida, where I was born and raised. After I graduated high school, I worked to pay my way through Yale University as the Team Captain of our baseball team, and then went on to graduate from Harvard Law School. In those years, I aspired for a great career, but when I witnessed the horrific events of September 11th, 2001, nothing else mattered to me except volunteering to serve in our military to defend freedom--no matter the cost. I deployed to Iraq with the U.S. Navy as a Judge Advocate General's Corps (JAG) Officer in support of SEAL Team 1, and it was the honor of my life to serve alongside fellow patriots, proudly wearing the cloth of my country as a badge of honor on our uniforms.
---
| [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=786c020c7dc041069a15c19075eba951&_e=mye8uEPi_tZ2IizkHB5UK1k4HQKNjYuodsy6SbsxP7mzJw9mX9JgfJaZvaoVIxt9U6Xdd3Lri3wEOtve5kf9qFHTJR-HifLy7wPnpxenv9hYay_NQMsoZTxIAXn5vknE12o-dAzes8zKHyb9dUtwIJAQicPfWVKc7yV8wczFf6EQBrfB05vDfYfDoI9I_usNvi8plJcVAccMePMPaqKRB6MHW5T0EyXN1BbEUcr53FtHYdLue8epbgr3CIRFnIr50SGPSWjPVYFs4sF1QklPWnu0dYCVpp90jOxrgKQ4iqwnHzTLkck_hCCGhXhAj58qHQYz4QvrfZ-s6d0-7Eqf0svhjKupAEmDKWyPDcJdlBAyJt050uqDQs-FBR6MemSjC_losai97RDVVDeUkBaX-OoJs8I0LPaAIOvhYYQlZGttOsNqbQOQ7CkUl3k-gaIK)
---
After my time in the service, I felt compelled to continue fighting for what's right and standing up for causes bigger than myself, and I've since been blessed to serve my community as a Congressman and now Governor of Florida. During my term as Governor, our nation was faced with COVID-19, and this pandemic exposed just how much leadership matters. It proved that our nation is in decline because elected leaders have lacked the necessary qualities to stay strong, fight for the people they serve, and chart a different course even if it goes against the grain of public opinion. In Florida, we showed that it can be done--success IS attainable--and I've let my record speak for itself. Two more titles I'm proud to hold are husband to my incredible wife Casey--the best First Lady I believe this state has ever seen--and father to my 6-, 5-, and 3-year-olds. As a father, I'm having to watch the radical Left shove a political agenda down parents' and kids' throats at every turn. They're having to face lies that men can get pregnant and that we should embrace feelings of hate and guilt instead of pride in our country. At this rate, if we don't make a change, we are facing the reality where we become the first generation to leave our children with a worse America than we inherited.
---
| [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=786c020c7dc041069a15c19075eba951&_e=mye8uEPi_tZ2IizkHB5UK1k4HQKNjYuodsy6SbsxP7mzJw9mX9JgfJaZvaoVIxt9U6Xdd3Lri3wEOtve5kf9qFHTJR-HifLy7wPnpxenv9hYay_NQMsoZTxIAXn5vknE12o-dAzes8zKHyb9dUtwIJAQicPfWVKc7yV8wczFf6EQBrfB05vDfYfDoI9I_usNvi8plJcVAccMePMPaqKRB6MHW5T0EyXN1BbEUcr53FtHYdLue8epbgr3CIRFnIr50SGPSWjPVYFs4sF1QklPWnu0dYCVpp90jOxrgKQ4iqxMeC8cFQGXVj1B3ELPG7CwItKzVXLpqm5KBlN0zzUrbAD3S2-BMkxtfP2DABvu1AcCXa0ev7v6epFLU0oa0G8FL0LsgydCfdloI3LIuj2l0-Gi1X40T8qzvNKG1TLDFFQyn9YugMv4kYEo2NtEWN_S)
---
But, Peter, we do not have to accept this decline. It CAN be reversed, and I believe we have a responsibility to step up and do it. This cannot wait another four years. If you share this belief in a better tomorrow with me, I am humbly asking you to join my team. You should know that every dollar counts in this race, and every contribution to my team goes so much farther than you could know. That's why, if you join my team by making any donation of just $5 or more, I want to welcome you with a free bumper sticker.
---
| [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=786c020c7dc041069a15c19075eba951&_e=mye8uEPi_tZ2IizkHB5UK1k4HQKNjYuodsy6SbsxP7mzJw9mX9JgfJaZvaoVIxt9U6Xdd3Lri3wEOtve5kf9qFHTJR-HifLy7wPnpxenv9hYay_NQMsoZTxIAXn5vknE12o-dAzes8zKHyb9dUtwIJAQicPfWVKc7yV8wczFf6EQBrfB05vDfYfDoI9I_usNvi8plJcVAccMePMPaqKRB6MHW5T0EyXN1BbEUcr53FtHYdLue8epbgr3CIRFnIr50SGPSWjPVYFs4sF1QklPWnu0dYCVpp90jOxrgKQ4iqzwLAf0Jz6qNTQJwsAXba9ooJ2UnIob_zaeY9OANoEmQZ0M-HQhZtvusxtF5nP3aYlhio2URTdu4iskBVEhqYkUTXk4PzjPVdattC1nNVbWckJ_rF7rAPUKmjls086Nt_8U3PmM6Id9c1qPs4bI6sWi)

| | [Join My Team: Send in Your First Donation!](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=786c020c7dc041069a15c19075eba951&_e=mye8uEPi_tZ2IizkHB5UK1k4HQKNjYuodsy6SbsxP7mzJw9mX9JgfJaZvaoVIxt9U6Xdd3Lri3wEOtve5kf9qFHTJR-HifLy7wPnpxenv9hYay_NQMsoZTxIAXn5vknE12o-dAzes8zKHyb9dUtwIJAQicPfWVKc7yV8wczFf6EQBrfB05vDfYfDoI9I_usNvi8plJcVAccMePMPaqKRB6MHW5T0EyXN1BbEUcr53FtHYdLue8epbgr3CIRFnIr50SGPSWjPVYFs4sF1QklPWnu0dYCVpp90jOxrgKQ4iqwqC9qaoG45vPkiea6p0Nh1Kq2_hcUNbFkpje_5XxrMD-H4BLZnjM6Cel0QJEE1ZKSzePIsM4gLa5V1kqj-BA3uEKfciUfwE3-QyvIqp4KupFi_7st3bvmhpMVu8bJVwXNHgTmKXPatJgb1X9fHpzqb)
---
While we put your contribution to good use out on the trail--reaching new voters, hosting big events, producing all kinds of merchandise, advertising across the country, building our network, raising the resources we need to keep going--you could be making an even bigger impact by spreading the word right where you are. I have made it my mission to always lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. With your help, we won't lose. We will reverse the decline of this country and get the job done. You'll see very quickly I'm not like anyone else in this race. In the state of Florida, everything I promised we would do, we've gotten done, and then some, when's the last time anybody you've elected has over-delivered on their promises? As your next President, I promise I'll do the same thing. It's time for the Republican party to buck this culture of losing. You can count on me, Peter. I hope I can count on you.

In Freedom
---

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.
---
