subject: Stew Peters and Caroline Kane Discuss the BRICS Alliance
body:
Caroline and Stew sat down to discuss the ramifications of the increasing number of nations signing on with the BRICS nations | | | |
---
| Dear Friends,

Please be sure and check out my most recent interview (link below), this time with Stew Peters. Stew and I sat down to talk about the possible ramifications of an increasing number of nations signing up with the original BRICS nations alliance (Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa).

I also want to encourage everyone to pray for America. We must ALL stand in the gap with a spirit of righteousness and conviction that our fight is a good one. We have thousands of illegals pouring across our Southern border daily from 60 different nations, harboring diseases, running lethal drugs, and trafficking men, women and children. Now we learn that just minutes north of Houston in Liberty County we have "Colony Ridge" (aka Terrenos Houston) which I toured on Tuesday. It's an 800 square mile area +/- that advertises that they will sell land to anyone without a credit check or social security number. It will eventually be home to some 100k+++ people. We are all horrified that this is happening and yet, this is not illegal. Why do we allow foreign nationals to own property in the US? In Mexico, the best an American could hope for is a 99 year lease. America is being sold right out from under our feet in more ways than one; a problem I intend to correct on my watch.

SAVE THE DATE for my holiday fundraiser with the exceptionally talented **Trey Taylor** on Friday, December 1, 2023.

PLEASE consider a donation today and thank you for your support,

Caroline Kane

Peter, AIPAC and
its Republican donors are intentionally targeting progressive members of

our movement ahead of the 2024 election cycle.

clean_body: We can’t keep funding apartheid. | | | Friend, Yesterday, President Biden met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu, whose far-right racist regime wants to eliminate Palestinians altogether. Thousands of Israelis have been protesting for months against Netanyahu’s recent judicial overhaul as a threat to Israel’s democracy. But for millions of Palestinians, Israel has never been a democracy. The Indigenous Palestinian people have been subjected to forced displacement and genocide, and they’re not allowed to become citizens or have basic rights. For calling out these human rights abuses, I’ve faced attacks from Republicans and Democrats who want to silence any criticism of Israel. Their denial enables ongoing apartheid. But I’m not backing down. So pro-apartheid AIPAC and its affiliated PACs are gearing up to try to defeat me and other members of our Squad as we run for re-election in 2024. | Funded largely by pro-Trump billionaires, AIPAC hosted Trump at their annual conference and endorsed over 100 far-right Republicans who tried to overturn 2020’s presidential election. They’re trying to destroy the progressive wing of the Democratic Party, because we’re building the power needed to end apartheid. Last year, AIPAC’s network spent over $1 million to flood my district with misinformation and attack ads in an attempt to mislead voters. But as the only Palestinian-American member of Congress, I will never stop fighting for a world where we can all be free. I will keep humanizing Palestinians, educating my colleagues in Congress, and calling to stop sending billions of U.S. taxpayer dollars each year to the Israeli military. Together, we can hold Israel’s government accountable for its ongoing war crimes. Together, we’ll keep building the movement for Palestinian liberation. Today, Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.’s chief of security, Gavin de Becker, released an important message about the issues our candidate faces on his campaign trail – at great personal and financial risk.

| [ ](https://www.kennedy24.com/?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_special_message_from_rfk1&n=1)
---
Dear Peter, Today, Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.’s chief of security, Gavin de Becker, released an important message about the issues our candidate faces on the campaign trail – at great personal and financial risk. [](https://www.kennedy24.com/help-me-protect-him-video?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_special_message_from_rfk1&n=2) Gavin is a world-class security expert and three-time presidential appointee who specializes in advising governments around the world on how to ensure the safety of elected and public officials. He’s developed threat assessment systems and security protocols that are used to keep Presidents, Supreme Court Justices, Governors, Congresspeople, and others safe. And, he is leading the security detail that is protecting Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. We’re grateful we have Gavin and his team at the helm protecting our campaign—because the Biden Administration has denied our repeated requests for protection by the Secret Service. **Since 1968, U.S. Presidential candidates have received Secret Service protection** , after Senator Robert F. Kennedy, Sr. —our candidate’s father— was assassinated at a campaign event while running for President. This decision from the Biden Administration to deny Secret Service protection isn’t only about safety. It’s also about draining our campaign of resources. Because we have to rely on private security, at times, as much as 30% of our campaign budget is spent on security bills. These funds could be used to open field offices or to bring RFK, Jr.‘s message directly to voters across the country. Instead, we have to use the money to hire the necessary security that the government should be providing. **It’s crazy that we have to ask our supporters to provide protection for Mr. Kennedy and his staff, but that’s where we are. Please consider donating today to make sure that Mr. Kennedy is safe throughout this entire campaign.** | [](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?amount=5&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_special_message_from_rfk1&n=3 "Give $5 ->") [Give $5 ->](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?amount=5&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_special_message_from_rfk1&n=3)

| Peter,

We’d like to honor Hispanic Heritage Month by highlighting Latina and Latino trailblazers in the fight for justice on all fronts – labor, environmental protection, and immigration, to name a few.

This week, we’re spotlighting Guatemalan-American labor activist Luisa Moreno.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70142929/428414270/919917611?refcode=BLU-SAN-20230921-1-EM&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODI2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwODg2YjFiOS1jZTU4LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aD3KaNdckqOwCJi3r1Qf5SKXG7VHdTQ-tkz4ZYxmHtA=)
After a short career in journalism, Moreno moved to New York, where she became an organizer with the American Federation of Labor.

Her work advocating for workers in the food and tobacco industry across the country led her to pioneer the _El Congreso del Pueblo de Habla Española,_ _or the National Congress of Spanish-Speaking Peoples._ Through this foundation, she led a movement to unify the Latino community in the US and set a powerful precedent for the labor movements that transformed US labor.

**Today and every day, we follow the example of labor champions like Luisa Moreno to guide our fight to ensure fair and equitable pay for workers of all industries.**

body:
But the fight isn’t over.
#
In 2021, Alexandria and Senator Ed Markey proposed a Civilian Climate Corps — a New Deal-style jobs training program to employ young people in good-paying, union jobs combating the climate crisis. Naysayers immediately called the idea ‘unrealistic’.
**But yesterday, President Biden made the American Climate Corps a reality** thanks to a massive, inside-outside organizing effort from countless communities and organizers — including the grassroots, youth-led Sunrise Movement.
The movement for our climate is beginning to crack the grip of fossil fuels on our politics. If we can win a Climate Corps by staying persistent and organized, **we can also win a Green New Deal.**
[Will you split a $5 contribution today to power Alexandria and Sunrise Movement's fight for a livable future? Every single contribution helps leverage our grassroots movement into real policy actions.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230921.OFZ8B7&refcode=em20230921-5024-P_FND_EGR_GND&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5024%2E2526796%2EfO2QM0)
**[Contribute](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230921.OFZ8B7&refcode=em20230921-5024-P_FND_EGR_GND&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5024%2E2526796%2EfO2QM0)**
In its first year, the American Climate Corps will employ 20,000 young people in high-demand skills in the clean energy sector. Inspired by the Civilian Conservation Corps, a Depression-era infrastructure program started by FDR that provided jobs for millions, **all positions will be paid and most will not require previous experience.**
The program is also designed to invest in and attract participants from frontline communities disproportionately impacted by the climate crisis.1
**This is a major victory for our movement. But there’s a lot more to be done.**
[Ideas like the Climate Corps are called ‘unrealistic’, but we can win a better world because of every single person who is demanding change. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Two more titles I'm proud to hold are husband to my incredible wife Casey--the best First Lady I believe this state has ever seen--and father to my 6-, 5-, and 3-year-olds. As a father, I'm having to watch the radical Left shove a political agenda down parents' and kids' throats at every turn. They're having to face lies that men can get pregnant and that we should embrace feelings of hate and guilt instead of pride in our country. At this rate, if we don't make a change, we are facing the reality where we become the first generation to leave our children with a worse America than we inherited. | But, Fellow Conservative, we do not have to accept this decline. It CAN be reversed, and I believe we have a responsibility to step up and do it. This cannot wait another four years. If you share this belief in a better tomorrow with me, I am humbly asking you to join my team. You should know that every dollar counts in this race, and every contribution to my team goes so much farther than you could know. That's why, if you join my team by making any donation of just $5 or more, I want to welcome you with a free bumper sticker. | | | While we put your contribution to good use out on the trail--reaching new voters, hosting big events, producing all kinds of merchandise, advertising across the country, building our network, raising the resources we need to keep going--you could be making an even bigger impact by spreading the word right where you are. I have made it my mission to always lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. With your help, we won't lose. We will reverse the decline of this country and get the job done. You'll see very quickly I'm not like anyone else in this race. In the state of Florida, everything I promised we would do, we've gotten done, and then some, when's the last time anybody you've elected has over-delivered on their promises? As your next President, I promise I'll do the same thing. It's time for the Republican party to buck this culture of losing. You can count on me, Fellow Conservative. I hope I can count on you. In Freedom | Ron DeSantis | | | Meet Ron DeSantis | | | | | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer. During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal. Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment. In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health. In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular. Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities: Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates, Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities, Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT, Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable, Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency, Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation, Turning Florida into a model for election integrity, Protecting the unborn, Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state, Expanding education freedom, Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities, Lowering prescription drug costs, Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable, Creating a universal school choice program, Delivering record-breaking tax relief, Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership, Supporting law enforcement and our veterans, Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders, Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court, ...and so much more. After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes. But history didn't stop there: Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points. Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall. Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism." Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Hi Peter,

I've been spending lots of time out on the campaign trail meeting thousands of inspiring Americans, so I'm reaching out to you today with the hope of us getting to know each other better. By the end of this email, after you've heard the story of where I come from, who I am, and why I'm running for President, if you're ready to join my team, I have something special I'd like to offer you. I'll start by telling you where I come from: My mom, a nurse, and dad, a box installer for Nielsen, moved across the Rust Belt before settling down in Florida, where I was born and raised. After I graduated high school, I worked to pay my way through Yale University as the Team Captain of our baseball team, and then went on to graduate from Harvard Law School. In those years, I aspired for a great career, but when I witnessed the horrific events of September 11th, 2001, nothing else mattered to me except volunteering to serve in our military to defend freedom--no matter the cost. I deployed to Iraq with the U.S. Navy as a Judge Advocate General's Corps (JAG) Officer in support of SEAL Team 1, and it was the honor of my life to serve alongside fellow patriots, proudly wearing the cloth of my country as a badge of honor on our uniforms.
---
| [](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=6c26f704ff324c789eaa8e579cf60499&_e=mPZsKeBua1HsvND10g4Nc14lUaSWZvY_ap2ddRigGGpJG-QE1yelgHe-MKUjf4o46aMcPHYXIMUBxwB_GzCA8XPahKOkjypC7nywqOfvEqMAbp2k9GgSm35F9ubU4q93GZfeHZXkhOrwY3ZZ5ndMTx1WeLPTFS1L6dBC2rxRbfEyYhaIN61ky45uoECfLl_65saqCXTl4LUYQP3QJYY7OLWkHAM28CCL-cmaZUq-H-Hsy_SLdalWGnhKLiH3mIwWH56xT5Wp-fv5SWLsvlpBHg1F3wKRr284XXRb_JfM52G9kQkH30IbrWSEubZfi4R7gq90oA1pFwC4GkAUREUeUMIq1y-VWt9gsohvCy-Tnl-R0e5SZgSZt_iILKy-MRMhml5-iD-AI1Q3ZnB1CSDnytIrbVaCxaLWQykuOiKAX8uguAxkbZ5n75GZ5dZlLMU5)

After my time in the service, I felt compelled to continue fighting for what's right and standing up for causes bigger than myself, and I've since been blessed to serve my community as a Congressman and now Governor of Florida. During my term as Governor, our nation was faced with COVID-19, and this pandemic exposed just how much leadership matters. It proved that our nation is in decline because elected leaders have lacked the necessary qualities to stay strong, fight for the people they serve, and chart a different course even if it goes against the grain of public opinion. In Florida, we showed that it can be done--success IS attainable--and I've let my record speak for itself. Two more titles I'm proud to hold are husband to my incredible wife Casey--the best First Lady I believe this state has ever seen--and father to my 6-, 5-, and 3-year-olds. As a father, I'm having to watch the radical Left shove a political agenda down parents' and kids' throats at every turn. They're having to face lies that men can get pregnant and that we should embrace feelings of hate and guilt instead of pride in our country. We’re committed to making sure no one on this team feels like they’re being treated like an ATM.
# [](https://act.losecruzpac.com/go/128?t=1&akid=98%2E623276%2ENYmef_)
Defeating Ted Cruz is going to take a sustained and statewide grassroots movement made up of everyday folks who are ready to part ways with our part-time senator.
**We know that’s a tall order — and it’s why we’re committed to making sure no one on this team feels like they’re being treated like an ATM.**
Our commitment to you is to keep you up to date on Cruz’s latest antics and make sure everyone knows why it’s so important to defeat him next November, not to extract every possible dollar from every possible person through any means possible. ([**That being said, if you’d like to pitch in to help us Lose Cruz, click here!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lc-20230921?amount=5&refcode=em20230921&refcode2=98_623276_NYmef_&akid=98%2E623276%2ENYmef_))
Other email programs are notorious for trying to make it seem like the world will literally end if every single person reading their email doesn’t donate the maximum legal amount _right now._ Others use deceptive tactics like fake “matches” that don’t actually exist.
Lose Cruz PAC isn’t doing either. We know the stakes are high, but we understand not everyone is always in a position to make a donation — and that’s okay! You’re still a valued member of this team and a crucial part of our movement to Lose Cruz.
In the end, a massive grassroots coalition built on shared interests and mutual respect will be more powerful than the powerful special interests bankrolling Ted’s campaign. We’re in this for the long haul, and we’re here to do it right.

body:
A multi-millionaire hedge fund exec is going to try to buy this seat.
#
Derek, guess who's back in PA.
**David McCormick just announced his candidacy to try to beat my friend Bob Casey and flip PA's other Senate seat red.** 🔴
In case you don't remember from our race last year, McCormick is a multi-millionaire hedge fund exec who can self-fund his campaign. In 2022 he tried to spend tens of millions of dollars to buy his way to the U.S. Senate.
Now, he's challenging Bob Casey -- **and Mitch McConnell has already promised that he'll have million$ in dirty super PAC money on his side.** 😡
**[We need all hands on deck. Can you rush a split donation between our campaign + Bob Casey so he can fight back and protect our narrow Democratic Senate majority?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230921-1?refcode=em20230921-1-8576&refcode2=8576_434096_k8L8up&akid=8576%2E434096%2Ek8L8up)**

Bob Casey is the kind of Senator Pennsylvania deserves -- he's spent his career fighting the ultra-wealthy + special interests that threaten PA's hardworking people. 💪
David McCormick, on the other hand, is a rich dude who can + likely will spend tens of millions from his own fortune to try to buy a seat in the Senate.
And up until recently, he was actually living in _Connecticut_ -- sound familiar?
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230921-1?refcode=em20230921-1&refcode2=8576_434096_k8L8up&akid=8576%2E434096%2Ek8L8up)

**[Can you help us keep PA blue, defend our narrow Senate majority, and re-elect Bob with a split donation right away? We've got to make sure he has the resources to stay competitive in this race.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230921-1?refcode=em20230921-1-8576&refcode2=8576_434096_k8L8up&akid=8576%2E434096%2Ek8L8up)**

❤️ John
